เจ้าของห้องคือฉันนะ
ここ、俺ん家なんですけど!?

description:
Kim Jinsoo ends up moving in with his personal bully... will he be able to find love between his bully and his crush?

(Source: Toomics)

titles.title: ร้านหนังสือแห่งรัก

description:
A job at a mysterious bookstore. 

(Source: Manta)

titles.title: Le vaisseau spatial de la Lady

description:
“Is this how I’m gonna die?” At the height of battle, a space sergeant meets her unfortunate end and enters the body of the cursed Miola de Langtree! Now this soldier-turned-princess’s only mission is to locate her spaceship and escape this fantasy world of frilly dresses and haughty manners. But the shuttle is nowhere to be found, a suspicious masked man is hounding her, and her own sister wants her dead?! Time for this sergeant to fight for survival the only way she knows how… by joining the prestigious Knights Order! Will she make it back to the stars she came from? Based on the hit novel. 

(Source: Tappytoon)

titles.title: A Combinacao Keystone: Amor na Segunda Base
รักของสองเรา คีย์สโตนคอมโบ
キーストーンロマンチックコンビ

description:
"Wholesome Romantic Comedy Of The Baseball Genius And The Baseball Mediocre!" 

Youngjun’s life’s been all about comparing himself with the Baseball Genius, Hyun; who totally set the standards for Yongjun’s baseball life 7 years ago. Youngjun hated him just a few encounters after. Insecurities were too strong to beat, and it was easier to doubt Hyun’s kindness and push it away. Hyun has never lived a mediocre life, and that was enough reason to hate. Although this time, Youngjun can’t take his eyes off of him, and Hyun has never left. After all, they are the Keystone Romantic Combo.

Many people fantasize about switching partners and embarking on wild amorous adventures, but sometimes it’s easier said than done! Ju-yeong and Mina are in a somewhat “happy” relationship, but things are just bland… until a magic dice comes into play! The dice’s power changes the couple’s chemistry together and adds zest to their love life. Just one toss and a whole new Mina emerges! Maybe those fantasies can be fulfilled after all…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Eun Woo’s never been one for attention. She’s kept her head low in the palace ever since she first arrived, and all she’s focused on is doing a good job. Her peaceful life is broken, however, when the prince calls her to his bedroom. Lee Hyun is known for never having the same maid in his chambers twice, but Eun Woo keeps lingering on his mind. A story about a lonely prince and a lovely maid—will love make the prince’s wild eyes lose their sharp edge? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: The Hellbound - Út a pokol felé

description:
Repent, or face hell on Earth! In Seoul, apparitions have started appearing before those who have done wrong to notify them of when they will die. A new religious group explains these happenings as God condemning people to make them live more righteously. Detective Jin is assigned to investigate the latest incident, just as his wife’s murderer is scheduled to be released from prison. 

(Source: WEBTOON) 

*Notes:
\- Includes four extra chapters.
\- Source of the Netflix drama of the same name released in November 2021.*

titles.title: บุตรสาวของจอมเวท

description:
Mabel’s been mocked her whole life for her nonexistent magical ability, but when she finally meets her true father, it’s the all-powerful archmage, Raquiel! Forced by an imperial pact to let her go long ago, he can now welcome her into his home, with his half-wolf butler, three nymph sisters, a fox halfling, and a kind disciple to watch over her. But dark secrets from his past threaten to catch up with them. Will his magic be enough to protect her? Could she even come into a power all her own?

*Source: Tapas*

“Every day, I ravenously awaited those 30 minutes”... Hwane is studious, careful, and serious. Jinha is popular, cool, and fun. They seemed so different, and yet, throughout high school, they secretly met up for silent, passionate encounters. Hwane treasured these moments—until he is betrayed by Jinha’s denial of him to their classmates. It haunts him even into adulthood. When chance brings them back together, will it restart their hot love or will they both be burned in disaster? 

(Source: Tapas)

Bark, bark! Yes, I aim to please and do your bidding. And I’ll certainly never bare my teeth – that is, as long as you don’t show your back. Because it’s a dog-eat-dog world out there. Whether you’re a judge, CEO, boss of the criminal underworld, or a nobody, it doesn’t matter. In the face of money, all are equal.

(Source: WEBTOON)

titles.title: Сегодняшний день я проживу с тобой

description:
"I just need to date someone too!"
Dohee Kang's had the biggest crush on her childhood friend, Jaehyuk Kim, for years. But after his girlfriend tells her to get her own boyfriend, Dohee declares she will. Handsome, but eccentric Wonyoung Goh, happens to overhear and takes an interest in her. Will love be able to bloom between them? 

(Source: Manta)

The hit series from Eun Song returns with officially updated artwork, chapters, and additional scenes! With the sudden outbreak of a deadly virus, humanity is thrown into chaos. The few who survive it are either transformed into horrible cannibalistic creatures called "Worms," or super-humans called "Anomalies." Haru, a young Anomaly student at New Seoul High School, dreams of joining the prestigious "ISO" - an organization formed to fight the war against this virus. But the future in store for him is nothing like he imagined... 

(Source: Tappytoon)

Remi Do has everything - she's super pretty, has the best brand sponsorships on social media, and gets 10,000 likes within seconds of posting a selfie. Oh, and she also has a serial-killing stalker following her every move. 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Living with 4 hot guys? She hates it. I-Rei and her mother become the center of attention when her mom wins a contest where a k-pop idol group comes to stay with them. Now I-Rei must deal with living with 4 extra family members and a love-struck mother. 

(Source: Manta) 

*Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.*

titles.title: From a Lady to the Queen
บัลลังก์แค้นจักรพรรดินี

description:
Betrayed by someone she held dear, Rizi's previous life ended with the fall of the guillotine... or it would have. Rizi awakens to find herself three years in the past, back before her life turned for the worse, back before people she thought she knew changed right before her eyes. Rizi won't be blinded again. This time, she'll cut tragedy off at the source.

(Source: Tapas)

A strange current between the mysterious transfer student 'Do Won-kyung' and the girl 'Choi Kang' who is mistaken for a man?

(Source: Toomics)

titles.title: Smurf's world สัญญาทาสนายไฮโซ
สัญญาทาสนายไฮโซ

description:
Kyu-Ho Je wants out. Hot, rich, and with a plan, he’s looking to get out of his family’s multinational mega corporation because, seriously, business is boring. He’ll need help to make more money quick - savvy money launderer Kang-Ha Nam (codename: Smurf) is perfect for the job! But it’s not easy keeping Kang-Ha close with paparazzi and family constantly on watch, and Kyu-Ho will need more than kidnapping and contracts to keep him in his grasp. Will he get more (and want more) than he bargained for? 

(Source: Tapas)

Jaehee comes across as a shy, hard-working high school teacher. But behind closed doors, she gets her kicks by kneeling at the end of a whip, with her childhood friend Huilin holding the handle. However, when Sulhwa joins the school as a student teacher, secrets and feelings long buried start to surface. Now Jaehee's about to learn just how much pleasure she can pull from pain. Back with the same writer and a new artist, “Lilith 2” follows on where “Lilith” left off. So strap in and enjoy the rest of the ride….

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: Averse de Phéromones 2. Travail de nuit
Averse de Phéromones 3. Comme un ouragan
Lluvia de Feromonas: Recopilación de historias Omegaverse
フェロモンシャワー〜オメガバース短編集〜
七海の如く押し寄せて (Chilyong)
深夜勤務 (肉汁ハンター)

description:
Juice Hunter, Chil-Yong, and Koz have teamed up to bring our readers a series of unique omegaverse stories featuring a variety of leading male couples. Our couples include a dominant alpha/omega, a dominant omega/alpha, and a recessive alpha/dominant omega. Kicking off the series is “Mockingbird:” a story where our lead omega, Kei, has a gambling addiction that’s left him with nothing but debt. And just when he thought he couldn’t fall any deeper, Mei steps in and offers him a solution. 

(Source: Lezhin) 

**Release includes:**

23-46. **Haeilcheoreom Millyeowa** (해일처럼 밀려와; Like a Tidal Wave) by Chil-Yong

*Notes:
\- Last story includes 2 Christmas extra chapters.
\- All stories contain a prologue.*

titles.title: No hay Descanso para el Ángel Blanco
There is no rest for White Angels

description:
Dahye is still haunted by the abuse she got from Yeonhwa. Fate has it, Dahye is able to carry out her revenge after so many years. In what ways will Dahye get her revenge, and will Yeonhwa be even affected by it? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: メイド・イン・ヘブン

description:
An orphan, Sherl Watson, leaves her job in London to work at the Taylor Mansion.
Rumors and a cloud of mystery surround the mansion as strange occurrences keep popping up.
Will Sherl and the other maids be able to get out alive or were they all doomed, to begin with? 

(Source: Pocket Comics)

titles.title: 宇宙でただ一つ輝く星

description:
In showbiz, anything can make or break you -- top actor Eunseong knows this all too well. A video of him confronting a stalker fan has gone viral and it could derail his career! His managers insist he needs to boost his image somehow. Enter Woojoo, the main dancer for a struggling idol group called Noble. They're total opposites: Eunseong is cold and commanding, while Woojoo is sweet and naive. But they're perfect for a “show-window bromance,” a fake friendship to make Eunseong look more appealing as he pretends to take Woojoo under his wing. As the unlikely duo becomes more popular, the stalker's return could destroy not only their fame but their very lives... But is their bromance really all an act and nothing more? 

*Chapter count includes two special episodes *

(Source: Tappytoon)**

Eden Jang's often been mistaken for a foreigner or a Korean who's lived abroad due to his appearance. One day, on his way to school in a new neighborhood he's just moved to, a 10-year-old Eden is confronted by foreigners who seem to think he's just like them. But being also lost and tired, he gets flustered and goes into a state of panic. It's then when a total stranger, Sarang, shows up and saves him. Coincidentally, Sarang lives next door to Eden, and the two become close like real brothers. To Eden, Sarang is the older brother-like figure he looks up to. He tags along Sarang wherever he goes, just like a puppy would its owner. But as Eden grows older, he realizes his feelings for Sarang were far more than just brotherly love. Unable to suppress his feelings any further, Eden ends up kissing Sarang on a live internet channel when he's drunk. The dynamics between the two change, and Eden becomes bolder, making sure Sarang knows how he feels. Will Sarang reciprocate his love? Is Eden merely like a younger brother to Sarang, or does he also have feelings for who?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

titles.title: แค้นนักรักให้เข็ด
セカンドラブは激しく

description:
On her deathbed, a beloved grandma leaves behind a terrifying last wish: for her granddaughter to reunite with the horrible, no-good ex-husband that didn’t last even one year! Garyung instead vows to live alone forever, even if that means giving up her entire inheritance. But when a disastrous fire threatens to rob Garyung of her hard-earned fashion empire, she is forced to come to terms with the money, and the man, at stake. Where there is hate, is there also... love? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

titles.title: 突然ですが、マフィアに寵愛されてます

description:
Yoon Yu-No is a small-time money launderer with a huge problem: he can’t seem to escape the sexual advances of his client Vasily Ivanovich Kaminsky, a handsome yet deadly Russian mafia boss. Yu-No is terrified of Kaminsky and determined to escape from him, but his attraction to the other man complicates matters. Will Yu-No be able to resist Kaminsky’s overtures and save himself? Or will he be devoured by Kaminsky’s unrelenting obsession? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: 幸運男子と不運男子の幸福量保存の法則

description: What will happen when the luckiest and unluckiest boy alive meet and try switching their lucks?! (Source: Toomics)

mangabaka_title: The Adventures of a Demon King's Daughter

I Was Born as the Demon Lord's Daughter
Les aventures de la fille du Roi Démon
Renací como la hija del rey demonio
The Adventures of a Demon King's Daughter
Tochter des Teufels: Eine turbulente Dämonenwelt

魔王の娘に生まれました

description:
Life’s not easy for a child of Heaven and Hell! Given a second chance to live, Jo-Ara was happy to trade her dire past for a world of fantasy and magic. The only catch is she was reborn as Irene Neros Parjunel, the beloved newborn child of the southern demon king! With the god of the underworld and her deceased mother watching over her, she sets out to discover her place in this world. Throw in a snarky angel godmother and a stubborn demon godfather, and it's the perfect setting for mischief and chaos! Will Irene succeed in helping her father battle the threats that plague him? And after making plenty of friends along the way, can she finally experience true love, too? 

(Source: TappyToon)

titles.title: เลือกสาวเบอร์ 101 เป็นราชินีสิ

description:
Reborn as the daughter of a humble family in the countryside, Evie Collins has settled into a quiet and uneventful life in the boonies. Everything changes when she becomes the sole commoner up against 100 noble ladies to marry Crown Prince Ikasha, one of the most powerful rulers in the world. But rumors say his face is horribly disfigured, always hidden behind a mask. Is that why his marriage is up to this most unusual contest? Can Evie hold her own against the field of haughty aristocrats and unravel the mysteries of the man behind the mask? Based on the hit novel. 

(Source: TappyToon)

What comes after an 11-year relationship? Is it marriage? Goodbye? Is love still out there? 

(Source: POCKET COMICS) 

*Note: Includes eight extra chapters.*

From succubus scrolls to magical slime - we have everything from your wildest fantasies! Eunwoo, an aspiring viral vlogger, steps inside the neighborhood's newest magic store and meets Arte, the handsome store manager. And behind him? Shelf after shelf of magical adult toys! 

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: คู่รักวิวาห์ต้องห้าม
禁婚令 朝鮮婚姻禁止令

description:
It’s been seven years since King Heon Lee declared a marriage ban in Joseon after the death of his wife. But one day, he comes across a woman named So-Rang Ye who claims she can summon the spirits of the dead. Though So-Rang was lying about her spiritual powers, she now has no choice but to put on an act for the king. As the secrets behind the mysterious death of the king’s wife and So-Rang’s past start unraveling, the red thread of fate becomes more entangled…

(Source: WEBTOON, edited) 

*Note: Includes eight extra chapters.*

titles.title: ล้มแล้วลุก มาพบกันใหม่
ライブ配信で会いましょう

description:
Ju-Hwan's dream is to become a popular online streamer! Will failed real estate agent Se-Jin be able to help him achieve his dreams? 

(Source: Toomics, edited)

titles.title: ยิ่งเกลียด ยิ่งรัก

description:
Ban Ji-Un is loved by all. No matter how chilly someone's exterior may seem, she always finds a way to break through. That is, until her classmate Lee Yu-Seon comes along. For some reason, Yu-Seon ignores Ji-Un’s every attempt to win her over. Ji-Un is dumbfounded that, despite her best efforts, she just can’t find a way to weasel her way into the standoffish student’s heart. But when the two have an unexpected encounter, they just might discover that it’s never when a girl is looking for love that she finds it. On the contrary…sometimes it comes from the place she least expects. 

(Source: Lezhin US, edited) 

*Note: Includes two extra chapters.*

Two mutant misfits find love.

May Han is a mutant in a world where people are divided into five species: dogs, cats, rabbits, tigers, and foxes. May, despite being a rabbit, is abnormally tall, and has been bullied her entire life for being such a mutant. What will happen when she meets another mutant, Jun Kang? Will she be able to reconcile her traumatizing past and find love in this unforgiving world?

(Source: Manta)

titles.title: Mi vecino no es de este mundo

description:
Here are the key components of our story: two unusually beautiful boys (known only as Big Master and Small Master), an abandoned church, a blood-buying business, and a homeless young girl named Han-Su – who has unwittingly contracted herself to participate in said business. Big Master wants Han-Su out of the church as soon as possible, but it turns out that each of these characters needs something from each other. Big Master needs customers for blood (and Han-Su's blood asap); Small Master needs a link to the human world, and any way to aggravate Big Master (read: Han-Su); and Han-Su needs to keep away from Big Master long enough to stay in the church until she can afford her own place. It seems the boys might have a lot of time on their hands, but how long does Han-Su have to figure out what she’s gotten herself into?

(Source: Lezhin, edited)

No Hay Nada Más Que Comer Excepto Tu
Nothing Else to Eat but You
There's Nothing Else to Eat but You
Мне нечего есть, кроме твоей силы
食べ物はあなたしかないよ

description:
200 years ago, the Great Demon Prelude was sealed by a legendary hero. Now awakened, he seeks out a girl named Freesia—who looks exactly like the hero—and asks her to die. But then he finds out that she's only 20. As his plan to regain his power by eating her, Prelude ends up as her… personal housekeeper?!

(Source: Manta)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

display_title: Puss in Suit, Pup in Tie
mangabaka_title: Puss in Suit, Pup in Tie

titles.title: Puss in Suit, Pup in Tie
Traje De Gato, Corbata De Perro

description:
Sunwoo looks like a harmless little puppy on the outside, but everyone in the office knows he's more of a feisty cat - sensitive and aloof, through and through. Hyunjin, on the other hand, is like a big friendly dog - always ready and oh-so-eager to befriend Sunwoo. After his fruitless efforts to avoid Hyunjin within the office, Sunwoo gives him an ultimatum that results in their unlikely new friendship. Rocky roads await the puss in suit and pup in tie! 

(Source: Lezhin US)

“I realised it then… That this summer would be the hottest one yet.” Why are we lonely when there are so many people everywhere? A question that seems destined to be asked today, when relationships are volatile and come and go with ease. Jae-hee and Seung-woo don't have the answer either, and turn to their dating apps for some semblance of comfort. But a simple tap of the phone screen will turn into an uncontrollable longing for one another when a single message pops up on the screen: “Hello, Stranger.”

titles.title: อาณาจักรนี้ราชินีครอง
女王の国～四人の女王候補生～

description:
Despite the Kingdom of Blenheim having a woman on the throne, it is a nation made for men. Women are restricted in what they can do, and those who think differently are reminded of their place. But now comes four ambitious girls with their sights set not only on the crown, but also on a revolution! Whose eccentric vision will shape the fate of this great kingdom? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

titles.title: เลือดของคุณจีเซล
ジゼルさんの血~不死の男に誘われて〜

description:
A rebellious spirit trapped in her marriage to a violent husband, Giselle leads a miserable life playing the role of a meek wife and lady. But one night, wandering her new home, Giselle discovers what seems to be a young boy trapped inside a cage. An inheritance from her husband’s eccentric father, the boy is considered a monster, an immortal “flower that feeds upon blood”. Despite her fear, Giselle begins to visit the boy nightly. Will these illicit meetings shatter life as she knows it?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Jung-Hoon is a freelance novelist, who very much enjoys his life as a newlywed. The only problem is, him and his sex are finding the sex unsatisfactory. One day, he comes across his gorgeous neighbor, Eun-Ju, and he just can't stop thinking about her...

(Source: TOPTOON+)

In the Trebian Empire’s mines, Aren and Toa led a life of harsh labor for 10 years. It was Aren’s dream to escape the mines together with his younger twin sister, Toa. However, it did not come into fruition. Toa ended her life through suicide. Losing the motivation to live without his sister, Aren commits to ending his own life. However, a mysterious figure nicknamed ‘Deed’ appears before him. Deed claims there is a method to revive Toa if Aren makes a contract with Deed…?

titles.title: モッパンストリーマー～朝鮮時代にタイムスリップ！？～

description:
High school mukbang streamer who specializes in spicy food.

One day, while looking at the necklace her mother gave her, she falls asleep. When she wakes up, she finds herself in the body of a poor girl, living in the Joseon Dynasty… 

(Source: Copin Comics)

Who you sleep, or why, how, when, how often – your sex life is no one’s business but your own.
But this is Nora’s story, and we’re just glad to be along for the ride.
Your average Korean girl in her late twenties, Nora’s decided to go against the code of general female conduct. She’s out to experience love, relationships, and cultures not her own, but according to her own rules. Swiping in her underwear on her couch? Check. 7am booty calls? Check. Dipping the proverbial toe into some light BDSM play? CHECK.
Join Nora as she learns about the world and herself one swipe at a time. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: El tiempo entre la luz y la oscuridad
El Tiempo entre un Perro y un Lobo
O Tempo Entre o Cão e o Lobo
The Time Between Dog and Wolf
ช่วงเวลาของหมาและหมาป่า
犬と狼の時間〜僕の刑務所生活〜

description:
Kiyo, a struggling young artist, suddenly finds himself pinned as the prime suspect in a serial murder case. And as if going to prison wasn't enough, he's thrown into an Alpha-only facility crawling with thirsty alphas who are all too eager to eat him up. Thanks to his mysterious new cellmate Iri, Kiyo is able to escape their clutches, but bigger problems await... 

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Includes 14 extra chapters.*

titles.title: เพื่อนรักวัยเด็ก

description:
I was disappointed to see she hadn't changed, but now, I think I like her for who she is!

(Source: Toomics)

When it comes to employment, Jinwon’s suffered a string of bad luck. So at 29 years old, he’s unemployed and studying again. Lucky for him, his sister’s just married into an elite (read: super rich) family, and she’s offered him part-time work as a housekeeper for her husband’s son. The job pays well, and the hours give him time to study. But it isn’t long before Jinwon discovers that this arrangement with his nephew will involve more than just housekeeping...

(Source: Lezhin)

Ever dreamed about your friend’s wife? How about a charming masseur, or a MILF who’s hired you as a tutor? In Sexual Exploits, an array of characters share their juiciest sexual experiences. Toeing the line between reality and fantasy, these stories will pull you in real, real close…

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes four extra chapters.*

Ever wanted to give it all up and book a one-way ticket to paradise? Well, Yeonwoo did just that. Upon arriving in Okinawa on a sultry summer night, she’s ready to kick back at her hotel with a cold beer and meet some cute guys. Ah, hang on - the hotel’s burnt down. Unfazed, she decides to go for a sneaky skinny-dip and work out a plan of action! But mid-swim, she gets into trouble and is saved by a mysterious man in a helmet. She wakes up in Yururi Guesthouse, and soon decides to stay (helmet-man turning out to be a hottie may have played a part.) After all, when the scenery’s as gorgeous as the staff and the guests are this, er, open-minded, who’d wanna leave? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Potts has always admired the beauty of human emotions... However the first human he speaks to has none. 

(Source: Lalatoon) 

*Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 16 extras.*

Hae-Na has been struggling to balance life and school ever since her father disappeared after winning the lottery. But one day, the appearance of some eccentric but attractive guys shakes up her world: Chae-Bin Do, a popular cute guy at school and a goblin, Yamagami Onisuke, a Japanese demon known as an Oni, and Wolfgang Lucifer Junior, a wolf-boy. They ask Hae-Na to be their bride and claim to have met her father: will she trust them? Where will these relationships lead her? 

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: The Secrets of the Willson Family
mangabaka_title: The Secrets of the Willson Family

titles.title: The Secrets of the Willson Family
ความลับของครอบครัววิลสัน

description:
Multi-million dollars in inheritance, but where is the money? Anna Willson arrives at her late grandfather's country villa expecting a holiday. Instead, she finds secret messages left for her by her grandfather and a bunch of suspicious people. Can she follow her grandfather’s clues to uncover her family's secrets and secure her inheritance before anyone else?

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: The Evil Cinderella Needs a Villain
mangabaka_title: The Evil Cinderella Needs a Villain

titles.title: La malvada cenicienta necesita a un villano
La malvada cenicienta necesita un villano
The Evil Cinderella Needs a Villain

description:
The villainess is getting married to the villain?!

Lily, a former villainess was killed by the man she loved. She was punished for her evil deeds, but when she woke up, she looked the same as before but was a supporting character in a novel.

"While I'm being abused by my stepmother every day, I'm also engaged to a trashy man?!"

Determined to reflect on her past mistakes and live a good life this time, she enters into a contract marriage with the future villain of the story in order to change his fate and leave her stepmother and two stepsisters behind.

"I do not need love to live a good life!"

The (now good) life of a former villainess who became the supporting character of a novel!

But I'm supposed to make you happy!

Dove has always been the black sheep among his fellow Angels-in-waiting. To finally come into his own as an official Angel, he must make his designated human happy. But his assignment, Ye-Na Jang, is a girl who already has it all — except love. Will Dove be able to fulfill her wishes?

(Source: Manta, edited)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter*

Soohyun, who runs a popular ASMR channel, scouts some new recruits to help him film and produce videos. There’s Joonhyuk, an ASMR fan, Hyesoo, who has an amazing voice (but who only joins because he’s got a huge crush on Joonhyuk), and Chanyoung, who joins to protect (?) Joonhyuk from Hyesoo. From the creator of “Voice of Love” comes a new BL series full of budding romance and tingles!

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: Circle Trap～巡り巡る運命の罠

description:
No-eul is searching for the traitor in his organization, but finds only Gang-jin, a man who claims to just be a regular old vagrant. Intrigued by Gang-jin's cool demeanor even in the face of his threats, No-eul decides to keep him locked up for the time being. But there has to be more to Gang-jin than he is letting on... In the end, what secrets is he harboring and what are No-eul's true intentions? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Do you know the history of millennial ginseng? According to legend, this plant with magical virtues could be reincarnated as a human by reaching the age of 1000 years. But she is a girl-plant, not easy to get used to the unpredictable daily life of men ... While she thought she had found her place, here she is accused ... of murder ?!

We couldn't do anything, but we believed we could. 

We met as high school seniors. I was full of angst, while you guys were so carefree and lovable. I was miserable and powerless, but you made me believe anything was possible — the time of our merry-go-round.

(Source: Manta)

titles.title: บทเรียนร้อนซ่อนบทรัก
公爵邸で家庭教師、始めました

description:
For Jace Walter, his successful future was all but guaranteed. He had top marks, graduated first in his class, and was in the final stages of landing a very prestigious job when he decided to pick a fight with the wrong noble. Three years after losing everything he had so diligently worked towards, he finally gets a temporary position working as a tutor for a family member of the elusive Duke. He’ll do anything to keep this job, but the duke is so handsome it’s hard to focus… 

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

display_title: The Poem of Aster and Hana
mangabaka_title: The Poem of Aster and Hana

titles.title: The Poem of Aster and Hana

description:
High schooler Hana Kim channels her pain and angst by leading a secret life as Sparrow, the live streamer! In her vids, she shares her love of poetry yet never her own face, because — let’s be honest — people are the worst, especially on the internet. Her cherished anonymity is broken when her classmate Aster discovers her private life and wants to get closer to her. Will she keep her distance from him? Or will she let down the walls she built to protect her heart from life’s cruel realities? 

(Source: Tapas)

Joseon's finest perfumer. 

Meet Arisol, the first female perfumer and aromatherapist of the Joseon Dynasty. Under the reign of King Seongjong, she cultivates her own plants and manages the perfumery of the royal court. Will she find love and success as she navigates her role as the scent master?

(Source: Manta)

display_title: The Secret Life of Empress Isana
mangabaka_title: The Secret Life of Empress Isana

titles.title: Ay Cadısı ve Güneş Kralı: Kurtuluşum
Bí mật của Hoàng phi Isana
La bruja de la luna y el rey sol: mi salvación
The Moon Witch and the Sun King: My Salvation
The Secret Life of Empress Isana
Լուսնի կախարդ և արևի արքան։ Իմ փրկությունը
วิชาลับฉบับราชินี
皇妃様のシークレットレッスン

description:
College student "Sa-Na" wakes up in the Body of "Isana Castilla" of the Titan Empire, sentenced to burn at the stake for practicing witchcraft! A chance encounter with Ludwig, the Crown Prince leads her on a path to become Empress, as she embarks on a journey to help the now Emperor combat evil rivals! What lies in store for the new Empress and her little secret? Will she manage to find her way back home?

(Source: POCKET COMICS, edited)

display_title: The Scandalous Secret of the Crown Princess
mangabaka_title: The Scandalous Secret of the Crown Princess

titles.title: The Scandalous Secret of the Crown Princess
次期王妃のけしからぬ秘密

description:
Min Bo-Ha possesses the psychic ability to read memories with her hands. Abandoned by the Min family and living from hand to mouth, one day she is given the position of the Crown Prince in place of her injured brother. Bo-Ha puts on makeup and tries to fulfill her duties as a Crown Prince, but little did she know this decision will change her life forever. 

(Source: POCKET COMICS, edited)

Havi is the girl who has it all. Money, looks, boys, you name it. She's got everything she could ever want... except for one thing. Her new boyfriend's virginity! Eager to have some fun with the guy she's hounded for a year, will Havi finally have her way with Yul? Or is getting this docile boy into bed more than she bargained for?! 

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Yang Seojun, director of Taeyang Solar, finds himself caught in a life-threatening storm during a vacation hike in Sweden. As he takes shelter, he meets a pretty writer named Ji Eun who offers him the last of her food as they await rescue. But when he's back home, he just can't forget her, so he concocts a company-funded writing contest to find her. It won't be easy... even his assistant has her reasons to prevent their reunion. Will Seojun find Ji Eun again, or will she be lost to him forever? 

(Source: Tapas)

Those girls aren't family! They're gold diggers! I'm not gonna let them mess with me. 

(Source: Toomics)

titles.title: พระราชวังแห่งบาร์โด

description:
Even in death or rebirth… You won’t be able to get rid of me… 

He ended his life because he was unable to accept the emperor, who had gone mad with obsession. But, after over a hundred years pass by… like fate or… fate playing some sick joke, he is born again, with his memories of his past fully intact. Even though he had made a vow to never see the emperor again, and had wished for nothing more than to have his memory wiped clean of him… Was he still unable to escape him even through death?! Despite his best efforts, he finds himself face-to-face with the reincarnation of the Emperor… 

*Note: The chapter count includes 5 extras.* 

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: เงารักซ่อนตะวัน
ソーラーエクリプス【連載】

description:
After striking a deal with the wealthy and powerful Edwin, Lai is tasked with an impossible mission. He must fool Prince Hector by posing as his rumored lover Ellen, to whom he bears a remarkable resemblance. But life in the palace isn't as easy as it sounds, as Lai is immediately subject to all kinds of harassment and hostility. What could Edwin possibly have in mind as the mastermind behind the scheme? Where is the real Ellen, and what exactly is his relationship with Hector? And now, with Lai in the picture - how will all these things come to change? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*"So you’re that gay guy, huh?”*
Stefan has flown all the way to Texas for his best friend Charlotte’s four-day wedding extravaganza! Unfortunately for him, that also means spending time with his nemesis of 10 years – Charlotte’s brother, Rand. But why is Rand acting so nice? Something strange is going on… 

(Source: Manta)

titles.title: キミの音色が聞こえる

description:
This is a story about a boy who can hear every tune coming from a different species known as muses when one day he meets a certain muse.

(Source: Toomics)

Cursed by God to live out nine wretched lifetimes as a human on Earth, Valentine has finally reached the ninth and final chapter of this long punishment. Reborn as a penniless kid living on the streets, "Lucien" must find a way to survive... But it seems even with eight lives' worth of experience, there are still mistakes to be made! In a tumultuous twist of destiny, could this miserable life lead to... a forbidden romance?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Since the day she was born, Ha-Yeon's life has been nothing but a series of misfortunes. Not only did she grow up with abusive parents, but she also received a 12-year prison sentence for their murder when she was 16. And as soon as she gets out of prison, she's dragged away to the infamous Supernova Capital because of her parents' massive debt. But when she faints there from exhaustion, a surprising someone takes pity on her— the director of the loan company himself! That's how Ha-Yeon wakes up to find herself at the aloof Tae-Man's home... and thus begins their life together under one roof. Though their situations are starkly different, it turns out that Tae-Man and Ha-Yeon share a painful history of family-related trauma. Will the unlikely pair be able to find the light in the darkness of life by leaning on each other? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

titles.title: บัลลังก์รักจักรพรรดิทมิฬ

description:
After learning that her younger sister sacrificed herself for her, Shin-Joo dies in an accident after saving a child that reminded her of her sibling. She wishes that if there is a god, may he give her a life that she can spend for her younger sister, and her prayers are seemingly answered, she is resurrected as the Pope by the name of “Charles Hildegarde!” But before she even realizes what's happening, she is kissed by a man. 

(Source: Copin Comics)

*“Wake up.”* These are the words Sora Han hears right before her heart stops and then begins to beat again. The first and only person in the world to successfully have a plant heart transplant, Sora has felt an inexplicable pull to go to outer space ever since her operation. At 25 years old, she finally gets the chance. But why does everything on the planet she travels to seem familiar? Sora learns more about herself on this journey than she could have ever imagined. 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Set in an Eastern fantasy backdrop, It's a love story entailing beautiful men in a rare and obsessive BL romance. It's got it all: acting macho, feeling regret, getting fussy, destroying all surroundings, enslaving skillful characters, and a couple that exceeds all expectations!

(Source: Copin Comics)

In a world divided into slaves (Spinels) and masters (Pels), Rowell is a young duke who refuses to abide by the established rules. His parents died defending the rights of Spinels, and he, too, has never bought or sold a slave in his life. Then one night, a runaway Spinel named Dev steals an heirloom pendant of Rowell’s and blackmails him into purchasing his services. Dev plans to use Rowell’s wealth and authority to find his lost family, so he does everything in his power to dominate the kindhearted Rowell. With years of bad blood between Pels and Spinels, will the two be able to see each other beyond their labels? Or will their differences be too great to overcome? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

titles.title: 天才主厨先生的恶魔小奶狗~求你不要碰我~

description:
Genius chef and restaurant owner Heemin hates relying on others so much that he’s called “Mr. On My Own”. Being known as a no-fluff, values-over-looks guy is all good in the workplace, except it means he has to hide an integral part of who he is… The fact that he’s a diehard fan of the K-pop group, Emotion! To be specific, Heemin is obsessed with Jeong-woon, but at a meet-and-greet, one of the other members, Yiyeon, keeps chatting him up. There’s no room for another #1 in Heemin’s heart…or is there? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: うちのアイツは噛みます！

description:
Hanna, a 28-year-old college student, is getting her second undergraduate degree to become a lawyer. However, she soon realizes that she was supposed to go to a law school instead of getting a second undergraduate degree. Out of money and out of place, she joins a start-up business club to make money. Working with four other slightly weird teammates, they are starting a pet clothing business together. This feels a little funky, but everything will be fine... right?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

“You need the money, and I have plenty of it… Don’t you think it’s a fair trade?”

“Tae-i Kwon” is a young youth suffering under a mountain of debt. No matter how hard he works, it seems the debt only keeps growing. Driven into a corner, he gets a high-paying job at a gay bar, and it is here he meets the CEO of the place, Odo Seo. Odo, who is being stalked by a mysterious pursuer, suggests a contractual fake relationship with Tae-i. What starts out as a quick stint to earn money for Tae-i becomes complex when he starts to fall in love with the ever sensual Odo Seo. But the closer he gets to Odo, the closer the dangers surrounding Odo approach to suffocate Tae-i. When the identity of Odo’s stalker slowly starts to unveil and Odo’s true intentions come to light, how will it shake Tae-i’s life around?

(Source: Copin Comics)

titles.title: ビッグライフ〜無名作家の逆転劇〜

description:
Jaegun Ha is an unsuccessful novelist at 27 years old with nothing to show for himself. That is until he discovers a mysterious box of items and a cat in a graveyard! Now Jaegun is able to channel the extraordinary writing abilities of a dead writer named Gunwoo Seo, and Jaegun’s career is propelled to celebrity status. But with the perks of success come new challenges... 

(Source: Tapas)

titles.title: Eat You When the Flowers Bloom

description: Lin Yuan helps his parents look after the flower shop every weekend. One day, a beautiful guest came to the flower shop, threatening to "seduce" Lin Yuan. Later, this guest launched a fierce offensive against him. On the night when Lin Yuan's feelings for this guest increased, he stumbled upon his unspeakable secret...

They say what happens in school, stays in school. But for me… it somehow keeps following me around.

(Source: Toomics)

Ha-Joon has been crushing on Eun-Woo ever since they started college together, but he hasn’t had any opportunities to get close with him. At least they have a class together this semester: a lecture taught by the popular Professor Seo Joo-Hyuk. Hours after the first class, Ha-Joon remembers he left his assignments in the classroom. Upon reaching the lecture hall, he becomes witness and accomplice to a series of private lessons Joo-Hyuk is giving Eun-Woo—lessons that unleash his own deepest, riskiest desires. 

(Source: Lezhin)

titles.title: Đếm ngược đến ngày tốt nghiệp
รอวันฉันมีนาย

description:
The end is in sight! With three months left till graduation, Muyoung is on the high-school home straight. And it’s gone pretty well! He’s student body president, gets good grades, and has never strayed from the straight and narrow. Then out of the blue, the mysterious transfer student, Chanhee, confesses his feelings to him! Muyoung is so taken aback that he barely manages to turn him down… But with 92 days left until graduation, there’s still plenty of time for love to blossom! 

(Source: Lezhin)

Have you ever suffered a tragic one-way love? I thought I was the only one with a pathetic and embarrassing crush. However, there were more people like me and unfortunately, we even formed a sad group named, "The Secret Crush Club."

(Source: Pocket Comics)

titles.title: มารักกับเหมียวมั้ยครับ
มารักกับเหมียวไหมครับ
ボクのすべてはキミのもの

description:
Yeo-ul has pop star-like looks but that hasn’t stopped him from being misunderstood his whole life. And with the school year finishing up, this summer break could be a lonely one. That is until one night a street cat follows Yeo-ul home. This persistent little guy won’t take no for an answer so Yeo-ul decides to take him in, adamant that it’ll be for one night only. However, after one little smooch, this kitty turns into a really buff - and really naked! - man. For Tater, the white cat, finding Yeo-ul is anything but a coincidence. And once Yeo-ul agrees to take care of him, this is his chance to pounce! But it turns out, being human isn’t as easy as it seems…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Seonu is an average college student until his life is turned upside down by a stranger named Shin, who claims to be his lover from a past life. To make things even wilder, Shin says he's a spirit! After Seonu reluctantly lets Shin into his home, all sorts of characters come out of the woodwork: a classmate claiming to be Shin’s true lover from the past, a man in black with mystical powers, and the charming owner of a café. With the help of an 800-year-old nymph, can Seonu piece together the mystery of this time-transcending love triangle?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Why does Alfred insist on living as an outcast? And why does Hollie try so hard to keep him company? Is there something going on between the two?

(Source: Toomics)

titles.title: この恋を知っているのは私だけ

description:
Hari is your average quiet girl who got assigned the bubbly Yeonju as a roommate, and somehow they became best friends. But just before Hari can tell her about her crush on a charming senior named Jinho, Yeonju says it first—and that they’re dating! After years of watching from the sidelines, Hari finally gets over him, but now he’s chasing after her... With no time for romance, Hari agrees to a blind date to get rid of Jinho. Who knew her blind date had an unrequited love of his own? 

(Source: Tapas)

As an unexpected descendant of a cursed family of mermaids, Eun-Woo's only hope of survival is to never fall in love. For years this was easy enough, until one day he's forced to confront his childhood friend and first kiss, Tae-Ho. But why has he come back, toying with Eun-Woo's heart? Can Eun-Woo resist Tae-Ho's pull or will he succumb to his hidden feelings, and ultimately, disaster?

(Source: Tappytoon) 

*Note: Includes eight extras.*

titles.title: オメガ教授のとろかせかた

description:
A competent but inferiority complex-ridden Recessive Alpha, Jihyung's ultimate objective is to become a professor. But when Eunsung, the new, youngest professor at school, becomes his advising professor, his plans go awry. Feeling great jealousy toward Eunsung, an Omega disguised as an Alpha, he decides to use him instead to achieve his goals.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

*Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.*

The futures Evan sees with his ability were never wrong. Will that be the case this time, too? 

(Source: Toomics)

Hyeok-Ju is finally done with his high school, waitlisted for a college he applied. A strange girl comes into his life asking him to give up his waitlist in exchange for sex. Like any other man, Hyeok-Ju is intrigued by the offer and makes a choice that no one saw it coming.

(Source: TOPTOON+, edited)

titles.title: もしも、幼馴染を抱いたなら

description:
Head down to the gym, and get yourself a trainer. But be careful, or you'll end up getting closer to her than you think. Want me to help you with the stretching? 

(Source: TOPTOON+)

titles.title: บันนี่กับเหล่าโอป้า
バニとイケメンのお兄ちゃんたち

description:
When Bunny told the world she only cared about personality, she really meant it...until her personality-hire of a boyfriend turned out to be a complete jerk! It’s time to accept the truth: handsome men are the best! Now, Bunny is determined to stay single for the rest of her college life, appreciating handsome men from afar. But when five gorgeous men appear in her life, things get complicated. A simple glance at any one of them has her heart racing. How will Bunny survive their charms? 

(Source: Tapas)

My life after losing you.

Every night, I still picture Bangwool waking me in the morning, waiting by the door for my return, the two of us going out for night walks... But she's gone now, and all I have is grief and regret. She was more than a pet — she was family. I know she'd hate to see me so sad. But how do I move on?

(Source: Manta)

*Note: Chapter count includes an epilogue.*

titles.title: Aullando a la luz de la luna
Howling Under the Moonlight - Uivando ao Luar
Sous la Lueur de la Lune
กระซิบรักใต้แสงจันทร์
月にハウリング〜オオカミ男と獣医さん〜

description:
Yoon works at an animal hospital. Eun-Woo comes every so often to the vet to get treated which gets on Yoon's nerves. In order to treat Eun-Woo's wounds, Yoon takes off his mask and is absolutely captivated by his good looks.

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: I Give Up On My First Love As of Today!
mangabaka_title: I Give Up On My First Love As of Today!

titles.title: I Give Up On my First Love
I Give Up On My First Love As of Today!
I'll Give Up on My First Love Starting Today!

description:
Adam is a high school boy who has been separated from his childhood crush Beau since he was 9

One day, a handsome model transferred into his class, and the person turns out to be Beau!

Since Beau is so different now, Adam is unsure of how their love will play out

(Source: INKR Comics)

titles.title: El primer amor del emperador tirano
El primer amor de un tirano
The First Love of the Tyrant Emperor
รักแรกของจักรพรรดิทรราช

description:
From the moment she woke up in a foreign land with no memories of her past, Dia knew she was fated for misery. Taken in by a baron but beaten and abused for four long years, her only friend was the eldest son of House Knolls. (Source: Pocket Comics)

Father Daniel is a new teacher at Kaebiji Private High School, a school that is known for being a dump where all the local delinquents gather. He is adjusting to his new life well until one night when he stumbles upon a woman while on patrol… and finds her beating a man. Sensing that something is off, Father Daniel reports the incident to the faculty the next day, only to realize that the woman, Miss Sasha, is also a teacher at the school. A strange relationship between a devoted priest and a kind teacher both disguised as angels begins... 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

titles.title: Shh the Kid Is Gonna Wake Up
Shh, You'll Wake up the Child

description:
Hwan, a college student, is introduced to a part time job of babysitting.
To his surprise, Nabi, his employer, makes a move on him on his first night of work.
He is even more surprised when Nabi seems to casually brush off this encounter and signs him on for work. 

So begins a peculiar working environment, as Hwan starts to care for Yoojoo, Nabi's son, and things get more personal and complicated between Hwan and Nabi 

(Source: Pocket Comics) 

*Note: The chapter count includes a prologue.*

The older guy she’s had a one-way crush on for years vs. the younger guy she can’t stop thinking about… Who will she choose?
June, a political reporter at a newspaper giant, decides to quit her job after her boss turns down her idea for a gutsy and powerful political piece… ...And ends up getting a job offer from her long-time crush who also happens to hold a high position at a massive film company.
She meets the big up-and-coming actor, Tae-Oh, her first day on set and finds his attitude nothing but suspicious. June, giddy from all the time she gets to spend with her crush, Jung-Woo, finds herself blindsided by a proposal from none other than the hot actor himself! 

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: 谁是甜蜜的欺诈师/甜蜜骗局

description:
Still recovering from his past scars and navigating his attraction to the same sex, Unyul prefers to keep to himself—that is, while enjoying a low radar FWB relationship with his roommate and best friend. Then, comes along Seoha Han, a "god-given" perfection of a human being that is his exact ideal type. Opening himself up to love once more, Unyul must work to maintain his existing relationship with his roommate while trying to build himself a new one with his "lovely" Seoha. It's okay to pretend a little in front of the person you like, right? Will they still love me after knowing who I truly am? Who is this sweet, sweet swindler? 

(Source: POCKET COMICS) 

*Note: Includes 33 extra chapters.*

Early one morning, Yoojin awakens bleary-eyed to a bright light… Did he fall asleep with the TV on? Surely that isn’t a real-life actor sleeping beside him? No, there’s no mistaking it. The dreamy TV star Ryu Se-ryeon is actually in his bed… and he REEKS of alcohol! How?! When?! WHY?! Perhaps it has something to do with Yoojin’s sister, who just happens to be Se-ryeon’s girlfriend. Sound complicated? You ain’t seen nothin’ yet… 

(Source: Lezhin)

display_title: The Girl Hiding in the Wall
mangabaka_title: The Girl Hiding in the Wall
romanized_title: Nal Bogo Gayo: Byeog-e Sum-eun Yeoja

titles.title: Nal Bogo Gayo: Byeog-e Sum-eun Yeoja
Nal Bogo Gayo: Byeog-e Sumeun Yeoja
The Girl Hiding in the Wall
生靈～藏在牆壁裡的女人～

description:
Na Bomi is your typical office worker…with a secret. A chronic exhibitionist, she yearns to roam around naked, showing everyone what she has to offer. When a particularly risky escapade leads to an unfortunate accident, she undergoes an out-of-body experience. As a bodyless soul, she can parade around butt naked with no fear of getting caught! Is this her chance? Will she be able to indulge in her repressed desires? 

(Source: Lezhin)

titles.title: How to Live the Right Life

description:
The "perfect" girl Noa, known throughout school for her good behavior, gets kidnapped after school one day. But things don't quite go the way her kidnappers had planned... What will happen when it's no longer Good vs Bad, but Bad vs Bad?! 

(Source: Lezhin)

Lee Jung had it all. A handsome young man from a prestigious family, it seemed inevitable that he would live and die as a successful nobleman. However, life is full of the unexpected. When his father is suddenly condemned as a traitor, his good name gets sullied and he is forced to become a slave. Full of contempt for the family he now belongs to, Jung tries to seek revenge by hurting the daughter of the house, Seo Yi-Soo. Little does he know that she has many, many ways of "punishing" him.

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: โปรเจกต์รักอันตรายกับนายสุดฮอต

description:
The ever-loyal Juwon Lee gets a job as an undergrad intern, leaving Chanhee Cho behind for him to attend college classes alone. 

One day, Jaeyoon Suh, a classmate of Juwon, coincidentally witnesses the popular Juwon clinging to Chanhee. 

(Source: Copin Comics)

titles.title: คว้าดวงดาวอันร่วงหล่น

description:
A thrilling fantasy that transcends time and space for two men and a nine-tailed fox! Sung-Woo is a third-generation billionaire. Upon opening a jewelry box his grandfather left him, he wakes up Bi, the nine-tailed fox sealed in a marble. Equally absurd? Bi comes from the ancient Joseon dynasty of Korea!? Sung-Woo finds it difficult to soothe the outraged Bi and calls his cousin Yoo-Sung to help. Although Yoo-Sung has never been greedy, he feels a strong possessiveness for the first time with Bi. Yoo-Sung takes Bi back to his home, kicking off a wonderful love triangle! 

(Source: Lezhin)

When country boy Yewang enrolls at the prestigious Yeonghwa Academy to follow his favorite idol Jena Lee, he expects a life of glitz and glamor among Korea’s future elite. But he’s in for a rude awakening when he finds himself at the very bottom of the social ladder upon his arrival and targeted by the school bullies. Not only that, bullying seems to be normalized at Yeonghwa Academy, with victims designated as “Loafs”, who are essentially free targets. Finding allies along the way, Yewang sets out to fight back against his bullies and the school’s strict hierarchy.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Su-Han still misses his ex-girlfriend Ju-Ri, who left him without saying goodbye. One day, Su-Han runs into Ju-Ri, who is now his boss's fiancé. What will be the fate of the three...?

(Source: DAYcomics)

Takeru Inomata is a high school student living in a small provincial town. Rumors, marriage, children, or things people'd rather leave unsaid... it all goes way over his head. He's just living a quiet life without trouble or passion, taking each day as it comes. That is, until a new student enrolls in his school. Takeru's surprised to discover that the newcomer is none other than Kotaro, one of his classmates from elementary school. Soon, the teenagers start getting closer to each other... Is it the beginning of a new love ? 

(Source: Akata)

Can their love stand the test of time travel?

Bung-Do Kim, a scholar from the Joseon Dynasty, is sent to the 21st century by a magic talisman, where he falls in love with Hee-Jin Choi, an actress. But after a terrible accident, Hee-Jin and Bung-do find themselves thrown back in time. Will they be able to find their way back to each other?

(Source: Manta)

Yeonwoo falls in love with Dal after seeing him in his mother's graduation album. He dreams of Dal frequently after that, and decides to confess to Dal in his dreams. How will Yeonwoo and Dal's relationship develop? 

(Source: Lalatoon)

titles.title: วัยรุ่นวุ่นรัก

description:
Chungho thinks it’s unfair how Jun gets away with everything. Why should he be the one labeled as a troublemaker, when his best friend is clearly the one not sticking to the dress code? But then again…how could anyone not fall for Jun’s charms? He’s smart, popular, nice, and to top it all off…extremely handsome. It’s really no surprise Chungho himself’s been crushing on the guy for as long as they’ve known each other. Chungho tells himself that this is just enough, that he’s satisfied with liking Jun from a safe distance. But little does he know, his crush might not be so unrequited as he’d thought, and someone might be feeling the same way… 

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*The first sixteen chapters (Season 1) are R15. From chapter 17 (season 2) they are R19. Chapter count includes 5 extras and one special episode.*

Ah Reum Park, 34 years old. 11 years as Secretary to senior director of the strategic development department of the HK company. Not sure why, but my brother trusted and relied on her. But my brother's woman isn't to my liking. Although, that isn't really important.

*“I'm going to take everything that belonged to my brother. The first thing to take will be this position. And then...”*

(Source: Copin Comics)

titles.title: Why did you come to my house?

description:
In a house somewhere, sometime, there is a dark little creature. It creeps closer and closer, then presents a small red book. Its command is simple: read, and live. 

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

I'm only a little child in the eyes of my best friend's dad. He says he thinks of me as a daughter, but does he know? That I yearn for him every single day...

(Source: Copin Comics)

titles.title: 2車線道路の貫通工事をご案内いたします。

description:
Hye-Sol, a dom, is looking for a new “friend” for her sub partner. At a party, she spots Sun-Hwee, who’s recently returned to college after taking a 3-year break. While Sun-Hwee is eager to get with Hye-Sol, he is alarmed at how quickly things escalate to the next level. Hye-Sol makes it her project to break him in and promises to show him pleasure beyond his imagination. All Sun-Hwee has to do is...go far beyond his comfort zone. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes six extra chapters.*

In the far future, advanced technology made it possible to build a dome city in space. Chess arrives in this city after learning that Esther, his rich sister, has died.

(Source: INKR Comics)

titles.title: บันทึกรักของผมและเขา

description:
There are 5 famous pretty boys at school. Their odd natures disagree with their good looks. Now that Jun-Oh is their target, what will happen to him?! 

(Source: Webnovel)

*Notes:
\- Chapter count includes a prologue.
\- One of the winners of the 8th Mr. Blue BL & Romance comic awards.*

titles.title: The Foolish Dog and the Lady

description:
*“I'm going to do it, since you said you liked me.”* 

Dee-Ha is the assistant librarian of the city's female-only library. And Lougene is a half-blooded wolf spirit and a childhood friend of Dee-Ha. On the night of the winter festival, the two cross the line of friendship and have a secret affair. 

(Source: Copin Comics)

*Note: Includes five extra chapters.*

titles.title: ตะวัน จันทรา วารี

description:
The sun or the moon. Who do I choose?

Ever since they were little, Se-Un believed that he and his best friend Do-Bin only had each other. But when a rift between them makes room for the newcomer, Dae-Beom, Se-Un’s torn on who to choose: the beautiful but cold Do-Bin, or the warm and inviting Dae-Beom?

(Source: Manta)

titles.title: Ever Green ~ Utsuroni Kasaneru Boku wo Mite, Kami Demo Yaburenu Ai wo Chikatte
エヴァーグリーン～虚ろに重ねる僕を見て、神でも破れぬ愛を誓って

description:
Seo-Jin, a kind florist, finds himself thrown into events that span worlds and time when he rescues a mysterious man named Harold... a man he's seen before, in dreams. Fueled by burning curiosity and an addictive attraction, they will face the dark powers moving against them to seek answers. How did Harold end up in this world? Why does Seo-Jin look like Harold’s lost love, Helio? And can they find a way to be together in the face of their impossible odds?

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

display_title: Death Candle: The Hand of Death
mangabaka_title: Death Candle: The Hand of Death

titles.title: Death Candle: The Hand of Death
うつし世コンプレックス

description:
Please, help me die! 

Sick of living, Mimi has tried numerous times to take her own life. Much to her dismay, she somehow always ends up surviving. But then she comes across a website called "Death Candle" and ends up signing a contract with a demon of death: if Mimi helps him collect souls, he'll help her die. 

(Source: Manta)

Praised solely on her looks for years, Lia was eager to put everything behind her and start anew… Until she got kidnapped and tossed into the harem of an unknown ruler. Desperate and afraid, Lia makes a deal with Karian, the handsome yet ruthless regent to the king, who seems strangely drawn to her. Will Lia be able to keep up appearances as Karian’s concubine long enough to search for the hidden assassin in their midst? And once she does, will that be the very leverage she’ll need to make her escape? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

Centuries ago, wolves were cursed with an endless hunger and the only way to break it is to devour the heart of a Red Cloak - a descendant of the witch who cursed them. One wolf finally believes he may be able to break the curse of his species, but this Red Cloak is different than what the legends led them all to believe...

display_title: The Cold Glasshouse: A Fatal Game of Love
mangabaka_title: The Cold Glasshouse: A Fatal Game of Love

titles.title: The Cold Glasshouse: A Fatal Game of Love

description:
Sejin works at one of the most renowned flower shops in the capital. But his interest is not in horticulture, but to seek revenge on Junghoo Choi, the owner of a fancy high-end salon. Sejin believes that Junghoo is responsible for the death of Doyoung whom he loved. As a mere flower shop assistant, he cannot directly go after Junghoo, so he decides to use Kyuryeon, Junghoo's closest confident, to achieve his goal. But one day, arrogant playboy Kyuryeon starts coming onto Sejin and offers Sejin a deal. Should Sejin win him over by the time the glasshouse he commissioned is built, he will help Sejin get what he wants, even if it means the death of his friend. A fatal game of love and romance begins between the two. Will Sejin be able to seek retribution for his old love and free himself from guilt and shame?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

U-Hyeon’s life isn’t great, but it isn’t terrible either. Sure his boss gives him a hard time, but he’s got a stable corporate job that pays the bills. He can’t exactly remember what made him fall for his boyfriend, Seok-Il, but hey, he’s handsome. But when U-Hyeon bumps into his high school love, Min-Hyeok, he realizes that the magnetic spark is still there, even after a decade. And for the first time in a long time, U-Hyeon feels totally alive.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

titles.title: あの子は俺の思い通り～尽くす系女子の手懐け方～

description:
Nothing went the way I wanted it to in my life, until... she gave her everything to me!

(Source: Toomics)

A stiff bodyguard-turned-model manager lives in stark contrast to his twin brother's relaxed lifestyle.
Can he find it in him to let go and love?

(Source: Toomics)

*"You decide the fate of humanity."*

Gana's mother disappeared when he was young, but he believes she may have turned into a dolphin since he can communicate with them. Bullied by his family and other villagers, Gana must decide if he thinks all humans should perish, or if there are enough good ones to cancel out the bad. 

(Source: Manta)

A single father raising twins wants nothing but the best for them, but he didn't expect that he'd need breast milk! A beautiful married woman offers to sell them, and things start to get real steamy...

(Source: TOPTOON+, edited)

titles.title: คู่รักสายคูล
クールな二人の恋愛事情

description:
A couple can't be more chill than this! Come take a look into their lives inside and outside of school.

(Source: Toomics)

*Note: Includes four extra chapters.*

titles.title: รวมรสรัก ฉบับ Yaoi

description:
This is a collection of short stories that depict the passion and romance of boy's love. Each couple go through different conflicts together that test their feelings for one another. A collection of boy's love webtoon ranging from romantic comedy to a murder mystery!

1-3. **Margaret Buinui Bimilgongbang** (마거릿 부인의 비밀공방, Lady Margaret's Secret Workshop) \[Eoreunyongsatang & Yulseo\]
Genius jeweller Jen works at Lady Margaret's Secret Workshop in exchange for “something” only the madame can offer. But what is that something...?

4-6. **Love and fever** (Love and fever, Love and fever) \[Yeoing\]
Hayoon asks his lover Junwoo to take of his shift at his part-time job, but Junwoo realizes what condition Hayoon is in and goes to visit him. As soon as the door opens... Hayoon is definitely in a strange state!

7-9. **Maid Yeonswae Sarinsageon** (메이드 연쇄 살인사건, Mass Maid Murderer) \[Gojo\]
In a world like 19th Century England, with no specified gender roles much like the real world, the age of the employee began, but there's a serial killer on the loose that only targets male maids! In order to solve the cases, Russel employs the maid Elliot...

10-12. **Dalkomsalbeolhan Geu Mueonga** (달콤살벌한 그 무언가, Sweet and Freaky/Sweet but Bloodly) \[Wangsaeuchyobap\]
Yoohan isn't family nor lover to Anjae, yet he provides him with warm food and a warm home. Anjae begins to slowly contemplate over his relationship with Yoohan...

13-15. **Nege Ppajin Jeom** (네게 빠진 점, Why I'm Into You/The Mark I Fell For) \[Lemi\]
Siyeon may be weak for beauties wih tear moles, but he's too weak when meeting with the perfectly ideal Eunha! What does he do? He can't stop thinking about Eunha!

16-20. **unfixable** (unfixable, unfixable) \[Innin\]
21-23. **Naega Iljiniya?** (내가 일진이야?, Am I the Bully?/I'm the Top Dog?) \[Kkomi & Etoe)
24-26. **Isanghyang** (이상향, The Perfect Scent/Aromatic Romance) \[Dona\]

(Source: INKR & Copin Comics)

titles.title: シェイムルーム〜囚われた義姉弟〜

description:
Wooyeon and his ex-stepsister Se-myung have been kidnapped. They awake in Shame Room, where they must complete a series of embarrassing missions in order to escape. As the pair lick, tug, suck and thrust their way through ever stranger and more perverted missions, how close will they become? Will their desires get the better of them? And will they ever get out?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Yu-Jun and Kang-Ha are two boys that meet at a studio by chance. A wound in Yu-Jun's hand entices a strange attraction from Kang-Ha, and a strange love story begins.

Two boys explore their feelings for each other as their hands intertwine in more ways than one.

(Source: INKR, edited)

After being beaten up by bullies, high school senior Yi-Yeon Kang wakes up from a coma, only to find the world in ruins from an alien invasion. The streets around him are littered and empty, with bullies out looking for their next prey. As he navigates this new world, despite being too weak, he is determined to find and save his friend Young-Lin. Between bullies, aliens and this post-apocalyptic reality, he'll do all he can to survive... and to bring down those out to get him. 

(Source: Tapas)

Getting struck by lightning, breaking a bone, failing examsㅡthese are the "accidents" that happen when one becomes friends with Jia. Bringing bad luck to people has been a condition of Jia's for as long as she can remember... until she meets Gun and Hyunㅡtwo mysterious brothers who happen to be wizards! With the help of magic, she's determined to ward off her curse no matter what. But does Jia realize what kind of sorcery she's actually getting herself into?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Two childhood friends birthed into different positions face the hatred and greed of foul people. See how their relationship blooms into a wonderful garden.

(Source: Toomics)

titles.title: I Want to Kill: Rebellion of an Indecent Married Woman
殺したい〜淫らな人妻の反抗〜

description:
Every man wants Si-ae. Her voluptuous figure and sultry stare make her irresistible, and she knows it. However, she’s put a life of lust behind her and tries her best to be content as a well-to-do housewife. That is, until Park Gijin comes back into her life. As the only man who managed to satiate Si-ae’s sexual urges, Gijin is the biggest threat to Si-ae’s cushy life. She knows that she needs to get rid of him, but she finds it harder and harder to resist the desire to… 

(Source: Lezhin)

titles.title: JDキスからカースト逆転

description:
Jin-Tae was supposed to have a great time at college but because of a cruel girl named Da-Gyeong, his reputation is in the dumps. But one day, he discovers her weakness.

*"Now how shall I get my revenge on her?"* 

(Source: TOPTOON+)

My girlfriend is a goddess, but she thinks of me as her slave. Just as I was getting tired of it, I meet her friend and experience something new!

(Source: Toomics)

“I missed you!” The tale of a dog who came back as a human!

(Source: Copin Comics)

titles.title: สลับร่างสร้างรัก
入れ替わった三角関係

description:
What do you do when your body gets switched with your crush's?! Sang-Yu is a painfully shy 18-year-old who has a crush on the class president, Da-Rim. But there's no way she'd ever return his feelings: Da-Rim is popular, smart, pretty... and she likes their classmate, Ho-Young. The three used to be friends when they were little, but a lot's changed since kindergarten. All this gets jumbled when Sang-Yu and Da-Rim have a life-changing encounter at the neighborhood park. All of a sudden, Sang-Yu and Da-Rim have a lot more to talk about, and Ho-Young finds himself feeling stirred as he watches the two grow closer.

(Source: Lezhin)

I have the cursed skill that lets me know who the criminals are. It's my job to get rid of them from this world.

(Source: Toomics)

titles.title: Ich bin verrückt nach meinem Boss
Je suis obsédé par mon boss
推し似の社長に迫られてます！？

description:
Otaku Oh Deok-Hae, who is a regular salaryman, has been suffering a lot lately. This is all because the boss at his company looks just like his favorite character, Cain!
The boss has a nice family, a beautiful face, amazing fashion sense, and great work ethics. Sadly, he doesn't like Deok-Hae.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

titles.title: ゴッド・ブレス・ユー

description:
Marriage is not on her agenda! When a two-time mixed martial arts champion dies and wakes up in the body of the petite Lady Grace Rambler, she quickly decides to make the best of things -- to attract a so-called “unicorn man,” the rare kind of gentleman who’s modest, exciting, and handsome! But her dreams are crushed when she finds out Grace is set to marry Duke Aston Blade, a perverted and ugly old geezer… Or is he?! Not willing to risk it, she rejects the marriage and sticks to her guns. It’s either a unicorn man or bust! 

(Source: Tappytoon)

The dark side of the psychopath and the "Holy" Father's intertwined story.
See how things aren't the way they seem.

(Source: Toomics, translated)

Do-Jin lost interest in all other women after a one-night stand with Yu-Yeong. He just cannot stop thinking about the woman that he met that night, and will do anything to see her again.

(Source: TOPTOON+, edited)

Holy Chicken is the hottest fried chicken place in town with a cult following for its mind blowing, delicious flavours and unbelievably good looking male servers. Yein, a lifelong fried chicken fanatic, stumbles into this mystical place and is about to take her reverence for fried chicken to a whole other level... 

(Source: Pocket Comics) 

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Stalked on a solo trip. Yeona, a middle-aged woman without much life experience, is ready to tackle her bucket list. First up is taking her very first solo trip — but it turns out she's not alone. Fast on her heels is a mysterious man. How does he know Yeona? And why is he following her, lurking in the shadows...?

(Source: Manta)

My wife’s identical twin moved into our house. But she’s a little naughty… Is the one seducing me my wife or my wife’s sister?! 

(Source: Toomics)

I must harvest the power of love! 

When a magical potion that can transform any living organism into a human goes awry, it’s up to Sarang the Chameleon to harvest the power of true love and save the Demon World. But can a chameleon masquerading as a human truly blend in with society and accomplish her goal? 

*Note: Chapter count includes an epilogue.* 

(Source: Manta)

Follow a bleak but honest tale of people from different backgrounds, all in their twenties.

(Source: Toomics)

titles.title: ทุกๆ วันของฉันและเธอ

description:
A childhood friendship ruined by a confession?! 

(Source: Manta)

The world has come to chaos. An unknown virus haunts every living soul, and one man is determined to reach his beloved before it's too late. His journey takes him closer and closer, but he faces adversity and strife. 

That's when he faces reality. He sees the world around him. He sees a world faced with something more dangerous than the virus. 

(Source: Tapas)

Handsome, stylish, and capable, Jinah is often mistaken as the heir of the company he works in. In reality, his polished look is just that--a facade he maintains in hopes of entering elite society. It’s not easy to keep up appearances, but Jinah is surely inching up the social ladder. Until, that is, a bungling subordinate nicknamed the “ticking bomb” is assigned to his team. Like Jinah, though, new team member Do-hyeon is not who he appears to be. 

(Source: Lezhin)

titles.title: 元教え子とオトナな実技演習

description:
It's always awkward seeing your former students in public. It's even more awkward when they show up at a club where you and your boys are prowling for some puss. Don't worry man, they're legal now. Just don't remember those high school memories...? 

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Seung-Ho accidentally went back in time to 2008. Join him in his new school life, where everything is different from what it was in the future! 

(Source: Toomics, translated)

titles.title: 欲張りなご近所付き合い

description:
A sweet looking woman moves in next door, but something's strange. Isn't she married? What's she doing?

(Source: Toomics)

What's Remy gonna do, now that the two most popular girls at school are obsessing over him?!

(Source: Toomics)

A detective moves in with a bombmaker. After his divorce and demotion, Detective Yoon thinks life can't possibly get worse. That is, until his sister asks him to move in with her fiancé Junggu, a former bombmaker trying to get a fresh start. But just as the two misfits become flatmates, Junggu's past comes to haunt him with a bang.

(Source: Manta)

titles.title: Compra uno y llévate otro gratis
こちら、おまけ付き商品です

description:
Working at a convenience store can be tough, but there's one special customer who gets me through the day. 

(Source: Toomics)

Ju-Hwan and Min-Jae are two of the school's most notorious and biggest bullies. Min-Jae's body gets possessed by the soul of a psychopathic and murderous criminal executed long ago. It's up to Ju-Hwan to stop his friends' criminal impulses and protect his friend Min-Jae from harm. 

(Source: INKR, edited)

I met her for the first time today... But why is my heart beating so fast?!

(Source: DAYcomics)

There's lots of ways to get a girl. Gyeong-Su has never had a girlfriend, and his friends are out to help him find one... The lesson begins now!

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

titles.title: ทาสรัก คุณหนูมือใหม่

description:
*"I'm never getting married!"*
Deok, a slave girl, would sooner choose death than let her future kids inherit this life. But then her master presents her with an absurd offer: *"I'll make you a noblewoman."* Deok is elated at the thought of escaping slavehood. But first, she must become a lady. 

(Source: Manta)

Jin-Ho Kim has survived the mysterious diseases that wiped out most of the population, including his parents, but struggles to find purpose in surviving one day at a time. Upon unexpectedly adopting a stray dog, Tony, Jin-Ho slowly begins to discover what it means to care and be responsible for another being, as he stumbles through being a first-time dog owner, and finding renewed meaning in this bleak world. 

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited) 

*Note: Includes a prologue chapter.*

display_title: The Two Eves : The Girl Trapped in the Wall
mangabaka_title: The Two Eves : The Girl Trapped in the Wall
