Две Евы: Девушка запертая в стенах
二人のイブ〜壁に閉じ込められた女〜

description:
What happens when a guy and a girl end up in an underground bunker together after the apocalypse? It seems like there’s only one inevitable answer when the Bongjoon finds himself locked in together with cute, curvy Hyun-mi for the rest of the foreseeable future. But things get complicated when sexy Nan-hee ends up joining them in the bunker with them. What happens when a guy ends up in an underground bunker with two busty babes? Bongjoon is about to find out the hard way!

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Teach Me How to Please You
mangabaka_title: Teach Me How to Please You

titles.title: Teach Me How to Please You
お願い、ロボット先生！〜色イロ教えてね♡〜

description:
From cooking skills to blowjob techniques, it’s Chang-nam’s job to make sure the robots at his training facility know how to act both in and outside the bedroom. But teaching these robots how to please their masters proves to be more complicated than programming a few commands…

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: จูบหลังม่าน บ้านซุปตาร์

description:
When Hallyu sensation Yoon Ga-Eul suddenly announces her retirement, it's a disaster for her management as they scramble to save both their own careers and hers. But Ga-Eul doesn't care about her acting career, the broken contracts, or even the penalty fees. What's most important to her now is getting to live a real life and finding someone who will finally take her side. And when she finds herself living under the same roof as a pair of bickering brothers, she may have just landed in the right hands. 

(Source: Tappytoon)

I got to see my neighbor's inside life by chance. What's happening to her? Why can't I take her off my mind?

(Source: Toomics)

titles.title: Let's Just Stick With It for a Week

description:
A one week romance with a guy you’ve never ever thought of before!

Chan-U's friend, who had implied that Chan-U was incapable of holding hands with a man, bets that he wouldn’t be able to date a man for a week. Angry at his provocation, Chan-U accepts the bet in the spur of the moment.

Chan-U's friend then points to Eun-Ho and asks him to date him for a week. However, Chan-U, who has a guilty conscience, decides to disclose the bet to Eun-Ho.
“I would like to be part of that bet too.”
"W-what?"
Should we… date for a week?

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

Ever heard of an “alpha mate” before? It’s someone who’s paid to be an alpha’s sexual plaything during their rut. Or a person who’s used by a non-alpha who wants to present as an alpha. Which is why Se-Jun is not at all pleased when his childhood crush, Yeon-Woo, is brought in as his alpha mate in the hopes of turning Se-Jun into a true alpha. Here’s a secret: Se-Jun is already an alpha. With a contract between them and a secret that Se-Jun is determined to keep, will these two be able to make a true connection? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Will Destiny's crush on a ghost-seeing cutie next door work out?

(Source: Toomics)

titles.title: 愛しき貴方に　～Dear My Lover～

description: If I can't have him, I wish nobody could. If only my sister could disappear...!" Felix, who fell in love with his sister's fiancé, Julian, knows she doesn't love him, but watching them from afar pains him. Felix, who wants to stay by Julian's side, gets a chance on the day of the wedding announcement.一 a possessive desire for Julian. Is it obsession? Or is it love?

My wife died in an accident, but my daughter looks so much like her. Is this wrong to do?

(Source: Toomics)

What is the first thing you remember? For high school genius Calliope, it's death. A bus crash, her best friend, her memories, they're all gone except for one: Brantley Pharmaceuticals. The world's leading technology company, they promise eternal life and... they've taken Calliope hostage. Experiment after experiment, her memories become clearer and clearer but reality all the more confusing. Where is she? What happened to her friend? And is she even Calliope... 

(Source: Tapas)

The Chois are a family whose people have sacrificed daughters in exchange for wealth and prosperity for generations. Having made a promise with an unknown man, the family has considered the birth of a girl a taboo for many years, in fear of losing their wealth… This is the Asian fantasy tale of the only girl born into the Choi family! 

(Source: Copin Comics)

Jun always wished to live freely, away from his father's meddling. He finally gets his own place and enjoys doing whatever he wants, without knowing that a strange girl lives there too!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Breaking up is always hard. But what if you go off on an amazing vacation right after? Especially with these beautiful women...

(Source: Toomics)

Miha has always felt like an outsider, even within his own family. Sohwa takes full advantage of that, forcing him to do his biddings. However, an incident takes place that helps Miha and Sohwa to reflect and figure out what they are feeling for each other. 

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

I thought money was the most truthful and purest object in this world, until... I met her!

(Source: Toomics)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Gemma's a sweet little girl... and also a dragon. She may look innocent with her curly hair and rosy cheeks, but deep down, she knows she’s a monster who can raze villages with a single breath. Because of this, she's hated and feared, even by those whom she once believed loved her. And then there’s Garin, the most ferocious dragon hunter (though a bit jaded) in all of Chrysos, now tasked with guiding Gemma to safe harbor. A mischievous dragon girl and a dragon hunter... what could go wrong? 

(Source: Tapas)

titles.title: Newbie in the Company Full of Women
New Employee in the Company Full of Women
ハーレム新入社員～入社したら男一人でした～

description:
How will Tyler survive his new job where he is the only man who also happens to have a little secret? 

(Source: Toomics)

titles.title: 道徳と道標～あの学校の秘密～

description:
*"Do I have to run away again?"* 

School teacher Yumi is back in her hometown. She's heard that her old elementary school uses "The Handbook of Morality" in their curriculum, and she's excited to start teaching there. But after running into an old classmate, Yumi is reminded of a past she's desperately tried to forget... 

(Source: Manta)

titles.title: สายใยรักอุดมคติ

description:
Sahee happens to witness a kiss between two of her guy friends, one of whom was her former crush. She's shocked and confused, which puts a strain on all their interactions. How will these relationships survive with everyone now living under one roof?! 

(Source: Manta)

Get ready for the adventure of a man with an explosive secret. Don't let his looks fool you... just a splash and you're his. 

(Source: Toomics)

20 years after an unsolved mass murder mystery, a billionaire falls terminally ill and the only regret he has is that he hasn't killed enough. He calls upon his 17 offspring in order to play a game of 'KILLS', a popular mobile game... in real life.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Men and Women, their secret desires, brought together through a completely private messaging app!

(Source: Toomics)

"A spell to change the genre of your life!” Yeah, that’d be nice. So far, Juwon’s existence has been pretty ordinary: a boring daily routine with zero romance to speak of. Then one day, he sees a movie where the main character’s life suddenly turns into a rom-com. Things have been weird ever since. Surely it can’t be down to the movie, but… guys just won’t leave him alone! His childhood friend, the cute barista from the coffee shop, his mean classmate, AND his first love?! Four hotties, all at once! Now Juwon stands at a crossroads. Which way will he turn? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Chapter count includes 11 extras.*

The legend of the guardian Dragon.
Back when God, sages, humans, and the Dragon coexisted, there was balance and harmony. But then the Dragon betrayed them and suddenly disappeared, and the world came to an end. This is the story of those left behind in the apocalypse, trapped by the bonds of time. 

(Source: Manta)

*Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.*

titles.title: Entre ma femme et sa sœur

description:
Yura and Steve lead quiet, normal lives in a sunny apartment. But when family secrets begin to get revealed, their worlds turn upside down!

(Source: Toomics) 

*Notes:
*\-A korean movie adaptation (처제길들이기 오리진) was released on September 3, 2021.**

A crazy love between two men who only know how to push away and hurt others! Sungjin Yoon is a man born into wealth who never experienced true love. It’s only after he listens to Phillip Jung play the piano that his heart starts beating. But it turns out, Phillip is a deprived, twisted child in the body of a man! The two are at each other’s throats as soon as they meet…! Will these two men be able to find true love? The tale of awkward emotions exploding behind a mask called perfection. 

(Source: Copin Comics)

A pretty girl popular in college is even popular in her own home! Her stepfather is always in pain trying to control himself not to cross the line. Will he be able to hold it in, or will his instincts drive him wild?

(Source: DAYcomics)

Jin-U is a struggling student who has to work several jobs. One day, he meets his best friend, Chan-Yeong and his girlfriend, Se-Jeong. Jin-U falls for Se-Jeong and breaks up with his girlfriend Yeo-Jin to be with her. However, Se-Jeong was not who she claimed to be... 

(Source: TOPTOON+, edited)

titles.title: キャットファイト～復讐のセオリー～

description:
How far is someone willing to go after they get their life taken away?

(Source: Toomics)

A man who owes a loan shark money and resorts to desperate measures to pay off his debt. A doctor who disposes of a body to cover up a crime and scrambles to keep his involvement hidden. A woman who is haunted by her past and seeks revenge against the men who have hurt her. Three very different people with their own reasons for committing terrible crimes, but when their paths intersect in a manner unforeseeable, their actions give rise to unimaginable consequences.

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

titles.title: Chut ! Le Secret De Ma Sœur

description:
After going down to the countryside to visit his grandmother, Hyunsoo finds that his cousin is not the same person he remembers...

(Source: Toomics)

titles.title: スターの彼女になってしまいました

description: Ten years as a manager. My level is chief, but suddenly, I was picked up by Korea’s top star Kim Dan and work like a new recruit?! The man famous for his bad personality, and now he is trying to tame me? You’re just making me do a lot of weird jobs that even doesn’t make sense! Why don’t you just wait and see? I’m not that easy! A contractual relationship between a top star and a manager, it’s starting now!

Sheila is such a great girl but if only she was more like my ex... 

(Source: Toomics)

Sanwoo is spending his summer employed as a custodian of an old house, where his lonely days are filled with nothing but manual labor and reflections on the past. One day, however, Sunwoo’s solitude is interrupted by the arrival of Eunjae, the handsome young heir of the house. As old memories and feelings come flooding back, slowly the two boys slip into a steamy summer passion. But when another visitor comes looking for Eunjae, that’s when things really begin to heat up…

(Source: Lezhin) *Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.*

titles.title: ทาสรักบรรณาการ

description:
Eunwoo is a yin from the small country of Hyun. After being looked down upon by his family, he’s offered as a tribute to the emperor. On his first day in the imperial walls, he succeeds in winning the emperor's favor. But life in the palace is hard for the naive Eunwoo... 

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: สาวร้ายเสน่ห์แรง

description:
The story of a woman and a curse that leads men to their death, will she be able to find happiness?

(Source: Toomics)

Chu Yeon-Hwa is a graduating student who always thinks about her first love from childhood. She meets a strange but wealthy man who reminds her of her first love, but she's unsure if it's him and after discovering this man's secret, Yeon-Hwa quickly falls for him, but she doubts her feelings.

(Source: INKR)

As part of a political marriage alliance, Princess Esmeralda Tuloise is sent far away from her home country of Morway to the Dirmuid Empire in order to marry Prince Patrick Dirmuid. However, not only is Prince Patrick still a young teen who’s nearly ten years younger than Princess Esmeralda, but he’s also a ruthless brat who lacks all sympathy toward other people, including his fiancée. Alone and looked down upon for being the princess of an “uncivilized and barbarous” kingdom, Princess Esmeralda wonders how she’ll be able to get through this marriage. That’s when the prince’s father, Emperor Alexandre Dirmuid, becomes the sole light in the princess’s dark tunnel. But the more attention he gives, the more Princess Esmeralda finds herself falling for the wrong royal... 

(Source: Tappytoon) 

*Note: The chapter count includes a prologue.*

"I'm sorry..." The second year of high school enters the new semester after the time when Juyeon and Mihyang, who became awkward with the rejected confession, avoided each other due to misunderstandings and worries. The two meet again, and with a fluttering heart, a slightly different special story begins. From the thrilling confession to the day when the first snow falls for the two

While Kayle is on the run and initiating a fake divorce from his wife, his friend agrees to take care of the poor woman... 

(Source: Toomics)

Back on campus after his military service, Jang Daechu can’t wait to get some action. However, a series of untimely events leaves him knee-deep in debt and with a tarnished reputation. All hope seems lost, but one day, he receives an invitation to the “Body Game.” The rules look simple: hide a number on your body, then find the numbers of three other participants. How? By having as much sex as you can! With 30 million won on the line, will this raunchy game help Daechu get back on his feet? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: What Thought Are In Your Mind Now?

description:
Ye-Ji’s been looking for the perfect man to date. Well, maybe more like “date” as in have fun in bed, someone who will give her a good time without making it all about himself. But that’s a tall order than you’d think, and how is she supposed to know who has the goods in the first place? It’s not like she can go around asking guys how big they are, can she? But who should confront her heads-on is none other than Min-Jae, a 20-year old guy in her department, when he greets her with his pants pulled down in the student council office. It later turns out the whole thing was an accident, but Ye-Ji’s already seen all of Min-Jae, and she certainly likes what she saw…

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

An ordinary high school boy, "Hero Kim," suddenly receives all his father's inheritance. And now, all the ladies are dying to sleep with him 

(Source: Toomics)

Mr. Kim, a broke guy in his 40's, suddenly wins the lottery and decides to go get what he's always wanted first...

(Source: Toomics)

titles.title: 僕らのラッキーナンバー

description:
Love doesn’t always work the way you want it to, at least that’s the case for Sojoong. Unfortunately for him, the love of his life, Ji-hoon, doesn’t love him as much as Sojoong thought he did. So heartbroken, he decides to break things off. But that doesn’t mean that Sojoong can just forget the love he felt or the memories they shared together. As he spends his days wallowing in misery, hoping for just one lucky opportunity to get in contact with Ji-hoon again, one falls right into his lap in the form of a winning lottery ticket that they purchased together. Now with an excuse to see Ji-hoon, could Sojoong manage to hit the jackpot just once more, this time with his love life? 

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Chapter count includes 10 extras.*

titles.title: 美しくて奇妙な影の庭園

description:
When young college grad Jung Seyi gets lost on the way to her grandma’s funeral, she seeks shelter at a botanical garden she stumbles across deep in the mountains. Before she knows it, she’s accepted a job as a member of the garden’s crew under the guidance of the mysterious but charming director. The whole situation seems like a dream come true, but as Seyi begins to have eerie visions and experience disturbing things, she quickly realizes that she may have been lured into a nightmare… 

(Source: Tapas) 

*Note: The chapter count includes a prologue.*

I believed I could become happy one day. I desperately tried, and I finally became happy. At least until I met him.

(Source: Toomics)

At the end of the war... the chosen one shall save the world! Gods and legends battle amidst the coming apocalypse.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Toomics](https://toomics.com/click/intro?cno=5480&pid=webtoonguide)

**Official English Translations:**  
[Toomics](https://toomics.com/en/webtoon/episode/toon/5127)

A new mobile game called Arcana Fantasy is all the rage across the globe. But here’s the game’s big secret: once a player decides to join the game, they’re unwittingly transported into a virtual world and trapped there until somebody beats the boss to clear the game. Yoon started the game to find his missing father, but now he’s in much more trouble than he bargained for. Will Yoon and his companions be able to find his father and escape from the blurred reality of this virtual imprisonment?

(Source: Lezhin X)

*Note: Winner of the Excellence Award in Lezhin's 4th World Comic Competition.*

It all happened so suddenly. I finally got to fulfill the fantasy I had with my wife's friend and right now? Nothing matters. All that remains is hunger and pleasure.

(Source: Toomics)

Ahyeon has harbored feelings for his next-door neighbor and close hyung, Seokjun ever since they were children. However, Ahyeon's world crumbles when he hears that Seokjun's affection was merely a facade. Heartbroken, Ahyeon flees abroad to pursue studies, hoping to escape the pain of his unrequited love. Upon his return to Korea, fate intertwines their paths once more as Ahyeon discovers that Seokjun is now the president of the company where he was hired! Despite his attempts to move on, Ahyeon finds himself trapped in a cycle of embarrassment whenever Seokjun's flirtatious advances resurface in the workplace, reopening wounds he thought had healed. Will Ahyeon be able to confront his feelings and navigate this unexpected proximity with his first love? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

"So that's why you should tell me quickly. I can't wait any longer..."

One day, after drinking to unconsciousness while comforting a heartbroken friend, someone kissed him on his lips. Seon-Il investigates the case to find out who among them was the criminal(?). But after he figures out who the guilty person was, he starts contemplating deeply about how to reject that person. But why does the suspect keep appearing cute to him...?

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

titles.title: Elskar อัญมณีแห่งคำมั่นสัญญา

description:
Hidden deep within the sanctuary of the forest lives the Rangae species, who form a precious jewel within their hearts once they reach adulthood. Viola, a young Rangae, has yet to form one when her village is attacked by human hunters. Due to her shocking resemblance to the late empress, she is rescued by Duke Khalid Alec Droy and assigned to serve the fifth imperial prince. Faced with the cruel hierarchy of high society and palace life, can Viola overcome her hatred of humans and discover the mysterious duke’s true intentions? 

(Source: TappyToons)

titles.title: 俺の兄ちゃん、俺の先生

description:
To the outside world, Kyujin and Doyeol are cousins who live together. But behind closed doors, the younger Doyeol is a reckless lover that Kyujin somehow can’t disobey. Unwittingly, Kyujin triggers Doyeol’s possessive side as he finds himself entangled with Jimin, a rebellious high schooler he’s tutoring. Cousin, teacher, and student—all roles and rules are bound to be broken.

(Source: Lehzin US)

Only the Slayer can save the world.

Long ago, vampires were created by the devil as destroyers of humanity. Now a vampire is after something but can disguise itself like anyone. What happens when an experienced and blood-crazed vampire gets loose in the city and no one is there to stop it?

(Source: Manta)

Things are about to get complicated when two brothers end up with a widowed stepmother. 

(Source: Toomics)

Le Jeune Maître et son Assistant
Secretary Kang and the Young Master

คุณชายตัวร้ายกับนายเลขาคัง
わがままお坊ちゃまにはお仕置きを

description:
Yoon Hee-Soo, is an illegitimate son of Dayoon Group, a leading conglomerate in Korea. 

"From now on, I'll be in charge of your moral education."
"..."
"Nobody cares."

Hee-Soo struggles to escape Kang Joo-Chan, the secretary who controls him and monitors his every move. For the past 10 years, they have tamed each other and been together that way.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

*Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.*

The year is 1951. Twenty-year-old wallflower Lee Kyeonga ekes out a living at the US military Post Exchange where goods and services of varying stripes are available for purchase. She peddles hand-painted portraits on silk handkerchiefs to soldiers passing through. When a handsome, young northern escapee and erstwhile fine artist is hired despite waning demand, an unlikely friendship blossoms into a young woman’s first brush with desire against the backdrop of the Korean War at its most devastating. 

(Source: Drawn & Quarterly)

Vincent, the agent of destiny, and Rue, the guardian, deliver presents to children around the world. These presents, known as 'the box of destiny' affect people's lives differently depending on the person's choice. The rule is that the agents must not interfere with the fate that the box brings, however, the warm-hearted Vincent often finds himself breaking the rules. One day, Detective Argio, who's been investigating a 30-year-old kidnapping case, meets Vincent, who looks strangely similar to a culprit he used to know. As Argio tries to uncover the mysteries behind Vincent, a new case of a missing child occurs and the evidences keep pointing towards Vincent as the prime suspect...

(Source: Copin Comics)

Jinwoo dreams to be a preschool teacher, but he has a scary aura and works at a gay bar. After an unfortunate incident in the bar, Yoo Chungha offered him to take care of his son. With Chungha's son being taken care of by Jinwoo, will he be able to let go of the past? 

(Source: MangaPlaza)

titles.title: Having an Affair with My Brother-in-Law
巡り合わせ～僕の義姉さん～

description:
A man and his younger brother go on their own adventures, but when their partners collide, tricky situations arise...

(Source: Toomics)

What would you do if you were able to clone things with a single touch? Sometimes, having two of everything isn't such a great idea.

(Source: Toomics)

Sweet and sexy stories based on the "entertainment world" ♥ Let's start their love story now! 

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

titles.title: L'apprentie corsaire et le trésor perdu

description:
For as long as Olga can remember, she's dreamed of setting sail and chasing down the hidden treasure that her father always told her about. But after her father and older brother go missing at sea, that dream seems like it too will be lost forever. That is, until pirates charge into her quiet English village, turning everything upside down! Now with a rag-tag team of sailors, can Olga finally unravel the mysteries of her family's disappearance and discover the treasure she always dreamed of? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

Meet Dong-hae: a meek and introverted person who finds himself growing more and more weary under the fists of his abusive lover, and Su-hyun: a handsome and successful dentist who cares little about what others think of him and even less about the private affairs of strangers. As people from completely opposite worlds, the two would normally have nothing to do with one another… but when Dong-hae comes in for his dentist appointments with broken teeth and a bruised face, Su-hyun just can’t seem to leave him alone. Together, could this unlikely pair find a whole new love that may prove greater than the sum of its parts? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

titles.title: 派遣モデル、紹介します

description:
My wife's new job as a posing model requires more than just posing?

(Source: Toomics)

Taesoo was at a drinking party when he got a dare to kiss his crush Gyeol. Very embarrassing indeed! But Gyeol doesn't seem to remember...? Later, in the future, they bump into each other and end up becoming roommates! How will their college life go now?

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/notjustroommate), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/notjustroo/), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000062012), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=10786634), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=240271), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/65962024)

titles.title: 异乡人:意外桃花源 / 阔少的女仆们

description:
A young charming man has some fun with his dad's mistress and gets kicked out of the family mansion in the countryside. He isn't too excited to move until he comes across the maids in the house. 

(Source: Toomics)

Two new girls move into a quiet town, but with everything there's more than meets the eye to this place.

(Source: Toomics)

Find out what happens when a man is tangled up with a girl who only means trouble. 

(Source: Toomics)

College freshman Haeri is in her first relationship ever and is head-over-heels for her boyfriend, Rion. In fact, she can't help but fantasize about doing all sorts of lewd things with him... but why won't he get the hint? Follow this young campus couple on their first forays into the world of sex in this steamy college romance!

(Source: TappyToon)

*Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.*

Hang-Ah is a goddess that has protected the kingdom of Hae since it's foundation, and it is due to her blessing that the Hae kingdom has prospered for a thousand years. However, after a thousand years, the blessing has disappeared, and various disasters hit the kingdom.

(Source: Lalatoon)

I'm the only man in this entire village?! Please leave me alone! Find out about the intriguing life of a young male teacher in a village full of women.

(Source: Toomics)

Jung Sookja's grandson, Gwon Yonghee, is her entire world. But everything comes crashing down after he ends up in a coma. The culprits behind it, the infamous Black Star Mob, are set free despite all evidence. Then one day, two men suddenly appear in front of Mrs. Jung, telling her they will train her so she can enact revenge on her grandson's assailants and take down the mob once and for all. Hesitant at first, she decides to work with them and begins to hunt down her prey one by one.

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Includes six extra chapters.*

A potato's journey to fitness.
After being stuck in a desk job for 3 years, Soom decides to take up swimming to tackle her poor fitness. Carefully selected swimming gear? Check! The itch for a toned body? Check! Soom is now ready to take on her new journey with enthusiasm. 

(Source: Manta)

The new manager of a K-pop idol group has been mistaken for a girl. Will he one day be able to reveal his secret?

(Source: Toomics)

“They see numbers above others’ heads?! A story of those who date until the set date”

Sungmin sees numbers above the heads of his dates. This is a story of his relationships despite already knowing how long each one will last.

(Source: Comikey)

An online store model, Juyeon Ye, wakes up and finds herself tied up in an abandoned school. It was her ex-boyfriend who kidnapped her, and there was no one to come to the rescue. The only person who was aware of her absence was her stalker, who had been following her since the horrible blind date. Now, she has to depend on the stalker to escape, and the tension between her ex and the stalker continues to intensify...

“Those eyes.”  
Before death approached after I was sacrificed, I met him.  
“You have no will to live.”  
He breathed in the scent from my neck as if it was the most fragrant thing.  
“Your last wishes, child.”

Those were the last words I heard in this life. I thought that moment was extremely awful. If only I was allowed to live one more time. Then. This time I will throw you people away first. Like a miracle, I returned to the past.

The Grand Duchy of Hessenguard lost its master. A young boy admirer of his planet’s greatest heroine gets a chance to take on her form when his heroine suffers an accident breaking her body up into pieces.

Sapana has grown up admiring her childhood heroine, Heroina, who saved him when he was just a child. One day, Heroina, who has been protecting the planet for what seems like a long time, suddenly leaves it saying, “This place has become peaceful. It is time to help other planets as well.” Upon learning this, Sapana is shocked, but soon does the craziest thing imaginable and stops away on a a spaceship to meet Heroina.

Sapana’s spacecraft, on it’s way to the point where Heroina has gone, is struck by a meteorite and crash lands on a little blue planet called Earth. So in order to keep her identity a secret, he finds employ, jet at a construction site in order to make enough money to fix his ship. While working, Sapana finds a piece of bright meteorite that breaks in his hand and he accidentally absorbs the light, a small fragment of Heroina‘s power. Now, with this new found power, Sapana realizes he can actually change into Heroina’s appearance, but even more so, other people can absorb other fragments and do mischievous things with them, and even worse still; Heroina is actually inside these fragments and Sapana must find them all to put his heroine back together again.

Yeon-jun is woman with a dream of becoming a film director in a world dominated by men. Driven towards obtaining the coveted director’s chair for a commercial film, she struggles against obstacles and name calling, until suddenly finding the solution to all her problems; the handsomely popular superstar named Do-hyun who she used to know when he was nothing but a fat, geeky wannabe.

Armed with this information, she approaches Do-hyun in order to blackmail him; either work for her as a star on this one film that’ll surely make her a success with his involvement, or suffer the consequences as she reveals to the world what he really used to look like when he was a child.

As she navigates her way around her first real film and deals with keeping Do-hyun in line, she also begins to succumb to his charms, all the while finding out other hardships that threaten to throw her, her film career and her budding relationship with someone she once used to loathe.

A young woman has a secret, she is actually half alien and feels like a recluse from the rest of the students until a young man takes notice of her and tries to win her over, showing her she is not a monster after all.

Byul, a freshman in space science university, gets caught up in bizarre rumors upon entering the school because she always wears a mask and never takes it off in public. So, there is an extreme rumors that she look like a monster under it.

Meanwhile, Min-sung, a simple-minded playboy, tries to dig up the secret behind the mask with his friend Seok-woo after feeling an unknown attraction to Byul, who’s usually lived alone without a friend, she ends up revealing her bare face at the goodwill of the two. Unexpectedly, Min-sung and Seok-woo keep her secret.

Byul seems to get over the crisis, but the secret is revealed when she realeases a sneeze that she was holding back and the mask falls on the table. Saliva melts the table which is actually hydrochloric acid and she reveals…

People’s get surprised by the shocking fact and now Min-sung tries to stay away from Byul like if they were strangers. A fortuneteller and her guardian warrior travel 600 years from the past into the present in order to find a young woman who can stop an apocalyptic even from happening. Together, they must navigate high school and fight off monsters, magic and evil.

During the Chosun Dynasty, in the year 1562, the country’s fortuneteller, fled her beloved country trying to escape the wrath of the barbaric Yeojin by traveling through a mystical pond along with her guardian warrior, Kim Jang. Once on the other side, the duo realize that they are no longer in the Chosun era, but rather in 2007 Korea.

Fast forward to 2017, a young student named Yoon-sul meets a monster called Sheng Soo, who is responsible for having killed her father 10 years prior, but before the monster can hurt her too, the fortuneteller, who is now 16 year old, and her warrior Kim Jang, appear to assist her.

The fortuneteller asks Kim Jang to protect her and reveals that Yoon-sul is somehow connected by power to the monster and themselves. As it turns out the duo have been following her ever since her dad was killed so many years ago, looking for a way to interact. What they are just finding out however is that Yun Bong, the leader of the Yeonsinnae, used the pond to travel back with them and has been preparing to bring her army from the past to the present and use their magic to take over the world. Now they must work together to stop this from happening.

She is accompanied by a person named Yoo-sung. Yoo-sung explains to Joon-hyung that Hye-lim while she may look human that she is of a different species. These species have been handed down as ‘Property’ from one generation to another. They tend to crave affection of a third party and kill themselves if they fail – placing their owners in grief. The Owner and Property fall in love but it is Hye-lim’s nature to seek affection from a third party. Time passes and Hye-lim is ‘reborn’ and goes back to Joon-hyung, but her instinct to seek love elsewhere doesn’t change. This causes problems between Joon-hyung, his best friend Tae-hyun, and his ex-lover Lana. Emotional distress, jealousy and drama ensues.

Meet Gwendolyn – living proof that princesses don't always have it all. See, although she lives in a castle and her father is the King, Gwendolyn isn’t like a movie princess, or even a fairly-tale princess. She’s got a big heart, but isn’t particularly attractive and doesn’t have a Disney-quality singing voice. But one night, she accidentally stumbles upon the twisted world of the Cursed Princess Club, and her life will never be the same. Hexed and cast out, the ladies of the club are just the people Gwendolyn needs to show her that just because she doesn’t “fit the mold” does not mean she’s any less of a princess.

It’s a hell of a job…

When Scarlet finds herself doomed to eternal punishment in Hell for a sinful life she can’t even remember, Satan himself offers her a deal: return to earth and kill one marked sinner per day…as his grim reaper!

Using the power of Hell, Scarlet quickly learns the ropes of being a reaper: bring in one sinner per day, regardless of their sins, and avoid the ninth circle herself. This work brings her into the path of Chase, a disgraced former detective trying to solve a high-level case that seems wrapped up in Scarlet’s former life. Scarlet decides to partner with Chase to find the answers to her locked memories—as long as Chase doesn’t discover Scarlet’s bloodstained bargain with Satan first.

description:
A Midsummer Night's Dream portrays the events surrounding the marriage of the Duke of Athens, Theseus, and Hippolyta. This includes the adventures of four young Athenian lovers and a group of six amateur actors (the mechanicals), who are controlled and manipulated by the fairies who inhabit the forest. The play is one of Shakespeare's most popular works for the stage and is widely performed across the world.

 (Source: Manga Classics)

Avery and Rhys rekindle their middle school hobby of hunting for ghosts in their senior year of college. Avery has aspirations to join the super elite paranormal investigators club, Ghost Encounters Inc., while Rhys is as skeptical as he is averse to being directly in moonlight. Slowly but surely they uncover the haunting secrets of their local abandoned asylum as well as their feelings for one another.

(Source: Tapas)

After losing her mother to a terrible illness, Yuki, a 16-year-old Japanese girl, thought she would be left all alone in the world. But she was wrong. Before passing away, her mother gave her a photograph of a boy Yuki had never seen before and told her that he was the brother she had never met.

By a twist of fate, Yuki spots a boy who looks exactly like the one in the photo her mother gave her, participating in a video game development contest in Spain. So she wastes no time and asks Enishi, her childhood friend who was studying to become a programmer, to help her out so they can enter the contest together.

The problem is that Yuki knows nothing about video games, and that starting a brotherly relationship with someone she doesn’t know at all won’t be easy.

*Source: Blanca Mira website, translated*

SHE CAN STEAL THE HEART OF EVERY GIRL...EXCEPT THE ONE WHO STOLE HER BIKE!

LEO'S the hottest senior at Princess Andromeda Academy, and her adoring fangirls have one goal: to beat her in a road race so she’ll go out with them. Unfortunately, the only thing Leo loves more than breaking hearts is her faithful old motorcycle, Bethany. But the arrival of mysterious new girl VEGA upends her daily routine forever.

Now it’s graduation season, and with her beloved motorcycle gone, Leo finds herself facing a lonely summer at an all-time low...until mysterious beauty Vega comes crashing back into her life. The two strike a deal that puts Leo’s bike - and dignity - on the line. Will Leo rise to the occasion, or lose Bethany forever? What’s Vega’s deal, anyway? And what's this burning feeling in both of their hearts??

description:
I guess you have to read and find out!  
Later on, the curiosity of the fujoshi gets the best of Misa...and she wishes to become a guy! How will Misa survive and navigate the world as a guy.  
Misa Nanase is a normal senior high school student except for the fact that she is a self-proclaimed ultimate-mega-ultra-omnipotent fujoshi queen of the intergalactic multiverse.  
One fateful day, she saves an old lady from getting hit by a car. In return, the old lady gives her an ocean green pendant and mentions that she can make any wish using it.  
Will she finally be able to do a live action BL that she has fantasized?

Original work:  
 TheYaoiArmy

Our hero Stud is a 14-year-old boy whose father regularly abandons him on expeditions that he regularly catalogs in his own journals. Having to fend for himself, Stud isn’t like most kids—he can turn his hands into hammers! Unfortunately, the kids in the village don’t think it’s cool and do not allow him to join their own fun adventures. Considering that his father has always advised him that friends are the most important accomplishment a person can make, what’s a boy who can turn part of his body into metal to do? Go on his own adventures, of course!

The notorious highwayman, John Black, has been robbing wealthy travelers across the English countryside. One night, he robs the coach of Phillip Challonier - son of the rich, powerful and corrupt local Earl. Phillip is captured and held for ransom. Far from frightened, Phillip is intrigued by this mysterious masked robber. As the night unfolds, captor and thief discover a shared past and a shared passion.

As Lt. Det. Esh Voss follows the darkening trail into Mia's death, his fight with insomnia begins to take over. His ongoing problematic relationship with Intuitive Counselor Jonah Leif, is only complicating matters and unlocking even deeper, more painful secrets from his tragic past. Refusing to accept that his nightmare visions may be real, and not just fragments of a sleep disorder, Voss tightens his grip on the tenuous reality he subscribes to at the determent of his own safety and care for those he protects.

It may have been the music that attracted her to band class, but it was love that made her stay…even if she doesn't have any musical talent whatsoever. But what high schooler Camilla lacks in ability, she makes up for in passion – especially when it comes to Victor, the handsome musician who’s caught her eye. Will love rule the day, even when your crush-of-choice is a real brass-hole?

Her ability to detect lies has made her an outstanding officer of the law – despite being haunted by her inability to save the ones she loved from a gruesome fate many years ago. Now, she uses her powerful gift to defend the defenseless at any cost – even if it means teaming up with a deadly assassin to fight evil in a world gone mad.

(Source: Webtoons)

What happens when your entire life is ruled by a prophecy – your future foretold by people you’ve never met, who died long before you were born. Such is the story of two young sea creatures. One believed to be a guiding light for his people, a Beacon who will lead them to a bright, prosperous future. The other is a teenage prince for who’s destiny is to KILL the Beacon so that HIS own people might thrive. When both reject the course set for them, it leads to a raucous adventure as big and unpredictable as the ocean itself – and a romance that nobody could have predicted.

(Source: Webtoons)

The last thing Ellin remembers is having to deal with a belligerent customer at her dead-end job. And when she opened her eyes… she’s “Solhwa,” the beautiful fourth concubine to the king of the Xyaran Empire. Between trying to learn the language and eating steak, Ellin’s trying to figure exactly what’s going on. Where is she? How did this happen? And who can she trust: Solhwa’s handsome charismatic childhood friend or the elegant, raven-haired king’s advisor?

(Source: Lezhin)

Charlie, a highly-strung, openly gay over-thinker, and Nick, a cheerful, soft-hearted rugby player, meet at a British all-boys grammar school. Friendship blooms quickly, but could there be something more...?

Poppy is a shy book editor who makes a grisly discovery in the countryside and is plunged into a world of danger. Along the way, she falls in love with QUINCEY the gentle son of a mafia lord, but finds her budding romance viciously crushed by Tora, his dangerous and unpredictable bodyguard - who can't seem to leave her alone, or keep his hands off her.

(Source: Webtoon)

When his relationship went down the drain, Chiko Dyer started to develop a weird relationship with a local delivery girl.

(Source: Line Webtoon)

Shin doesn't want to get close with anyone, being afraid of his own dad. New school, new people, same problems. After running away from abuse of his father one night, he encounters his classmate Joy. Something in Shin is not letting Joy ignore him, on the contrary, he wants to help this fragile boy with all he's got.
Source: Webcomics

The young prince, Deor, is an outcast in his own land. Born without the ability to use magius – a rare condition that marks him as an incompetent – he relies on his intelligence and tenacity to prove wrong those who believe he is not fit for the crown. However, with deadly demons and conspiracies threatening the very existence of humanity, Deor must protect the very kingdom which ridiculed him. Will he be able to defeat the demons and secure his position as king?

(Source: Webtoons)

A rainy night. A mysterious island. A boy with a dangerous story to tell – if only he could remember who or where he was. So begins a chilling journey into the unknown – when uncovering a twisted world of secrets is the only way to survive.(Source: LINE Webtoon)

David is what the supernatural crowd likes to call a “true believer,” a badge the teen wears proudly as he searches for the existence of all things scary and mysterious. When David, alongside his skeptical best friend Felix, are presented with proof that something terrifying may have landed right on their doorstep, the hunt for the Curse of Lalin is on - and life will never be the same again.

(Source: Webtoons)

Max is your average high school student trying to get through life as himself. He may not be your average boy, being assigned female at birth, but he's set on being the man he is. Though, trying to come out to his parents is one thing, his mom coming out as a Magical Girl is another. Now it is Max's responsibility to take on the family tradition of becoming the next Magical Girl and save humanity.

They were trained as children to become super-soldiers. Human beings literally created in a lab to fight on the front lines of a bloody war. But when the war ends, what’s to be done with the human-weapons? The subject of brutal experiments, some choose to break free and search for a cure before their own powers consume them.

(Source: Webtoon)

Being young, rich and handsome doesn’t always bring you happiness. Just ask Ivan, the black sheep of his family. If he wasn’t busy drinking, partying and being a royal screw up, he could be building a career in his father’s vast business. As if Ivan’s volatile family dynamics couldn't get any worse, he accidentally helps a supernatural entity steal a secret that could sink his father’s entire corporate empire.

(Source: Webtoons)

The sole survivor of a magical plague, Noam Álvaro is accepted into an academy where he will be expected to defend Carolinia, the nation that persecuted his family. Noam decides to use everything he learns to destroy Carolinia . . . that is until he becomes distracted by a mysterious and powerful classmate who warns him that nothing is as it seems. (Based on the YA novel by Victoria Lee.)

(Source: Webtoon)

Poor Matilda. All she wants out of life is to be a RuneTube star – sharing her escapades with fellow adventurers from around the world. But when you’re the granddaughter of a killer mafia boss, and necromancy is a family tradition, your life plans have a tendency to go awry.
Source: Webtoon
A music-loving teen with OCD does everything she can to find her way back to her mother during the historic race riots in 1969 Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. (Source: Webtoon)

He's an orphan with zero dollars in his wallet and no sense to his name, scrounging by on his angelic good looks and wide-eyed charm. When he attempts to steal from the famed Tristan Montgomery, Tristan recognizes in Manthony an unparalleled - but unrefined - talent for theft, and is compelled to take the young man under his wing. But will Manthony be able to pull off the greatest heist of all - stealing his gentleman teacher's heart?

Source: Tapas

Based on two of Shakespeare’s most beloved supporting characters, Everywhere and Nowhere follows the time travelling adventures of best friends Anne Guildenstern and William Rosencrantz, as they explore, fight and flirt their way through history. Their first stop is Ancient Greece, where the pair find themselves at the right hand of a very charismatic Greek leader loved by men and women alike, who also may just be bringing his people to the brink of war.

(Source: Webtoons)

Nita doesn’t hunt supernatural beings and sell their body parts on the black market – her mother does that. Nita only dissects the magical bodies for her mother. However, Nita's about to get a real taste of the family business and there is no turning back. Now, Nita must decide whether she is willing to become a monster... 

(Source: Webtoons)

When a gentle giant meets a small ball of energy, only love can bloom. A sweet love story about the advantage and disadvantage of being tall and small.

Source: Tapas

Life’s funny. One minute you're jobless, deep in debt and on the verge of eviction; the next you’re in a fight with a monster and getting a job working for a Paranormal Detective with the head of a Jack-o-Lantern. It’s an age-old story. Now the financially-challenged Ellie (who’s just discovered she has strong psychic powers) and her Pumpkin-headed boss Ichabod have to team up and fight the things that go bump in the night.

(Source: Webtoons)

Who is the most powerful man? The ruler? Or the one he listens to? Daerin has questioned this many times in his training to become the newest Grande Merle, Camelot's most powerful sorcerer and right hand of its king, the Arth. Can he shake the status quo and ensure the Arth's seat is no longer one of a puppet ruler? An action fantasy story inspired by the legends of King Arthur.

(Source - Tapas)

Bullied due to his extremely unattractive features, Grotie has given up on himself. However, he is determined to marry a beautiful girl so that he can leave behind beautiful children. When a contest opens to win the hand of the lovely Princess Allura, Grotie gives his all. Little does he know, the princess is also fighting alongside her suitors in disguise, to prove to her mother she can fight her own battles.

In a strange city, there is a clinic that will treat the victims of horrific, strange, and mysterious diseases. For a price.

(Source: Webtoons)

A former heir to the throne, Jinsei Kimura is now a fugitive on the run from the very empire he once called home. Now, to clear his name, Jinsei must fight alongside a team once sworn to deliver his head – working together to uncover the truth behind the coins that power their civilization. In a world without trust, where long-time allies are now enemies, can Jinsei harness the power of the Spirit Coins to find his own personal redemption?

Ever since her parents' funeral, Florette seems to only find solace in her flower shop and garden. Her love for nature is tested when she meets a tiny plant prince from a miniature plant world. With the “invaders” threatening his plant kingdom, Florette finds her calling to help save the world and its people. Could it be her botanist skills, or is there a bigger connection between Florette and the Kingdom of Soleil?
Source: Webtoon

Candy always dreamed of something more exciting than her secret double life. Sure, there’re her illicit nighttime meetings with Shun, the handsome class president with a double life of his own, but what good are cloaks without a little dagger? Lucky (or unlucky) for her, the new transfer student Jean is here to shake things up, and he just found out about Candy and Shun’s covert hobby. Can the pair keep themselves out of trouble, or will the covers get ripped off their private lives?

- Webtoons

Vior is Heaven's top Reaper and he only needs to collect one more soul before reincarnation. But, there's a problem... he can't kill his final target, an attractive man named Alex. Poison, car crashes, whether magic or more, Vior can't harm him. So, Alex makes a proposition: he will hand over his soul if... Vior can steal his heart. Can the romantically dense Vior make the narcissistic Alex fall for him and become human again?

Source: Tapas

Richie is a simple boy with a simple life. Yes, he has a distinct tomato allergy, and no, he's not interested in dating. That is until he goes on a blind date with Elle, the richest girl in the town of Overlook. It’s an awkward date that gets straight up weird when Elle asks him to fight aliens alongside her. Wait...what? It turns out, not only do aliens exist, but they're also linked to Richie's past. Now, Richie has to find the answers to his alien heritage, while hiding the true motives behind the fabricated romance between him and Elle. What could possibly go wrong? Not much, besides fighting seven mega-powerful alien heirs who threaten to destroy everything he loves. (Source: LINE Webtoon)

For work purposes, Noemi's family settled in the estate of one of the wealthiest families in the country. There she meets Blade, the hot-headed prince, and Soren, the illegitimate son. Enjoying simple days of innocence and love, Noemi's happy life quickly shatters into complete darkness. After tragedy, jealousy and betrayal, what will be waiting for Blade, Soren, and Noemi at the end of the road? Will love be able to save them?

Source: [Webtoon](https://www.webtoons.com/en/drama/midnight-rain/list?title_no=1797)
A wish always comes with the power to make it come true.
Memes from the internet turned into cute anime girls, Scripts by Merry and with artwork by Hinghoi, Rayno, AT2, Carillus, ErMao Wu, + Others

description:
When Pinkie Pie lends a hoof to help Twilight Sparkle and Spike clean up the castle Library, she discovers a mysterious mirror with the power to gaze into alternate realities. Upon entering the portal-like mirror, Pinkie Pie sets off a chain of events that could spell doom for Equestria!

(Source: Seven Seas)
Evangeline, a half-elf merchant, tries to earn her way to one million gold so that she can enter the Final City, a place where only the rich and powerful are allowed.
Read from left --> right, like a comic. Collection of unrelated short comics/ strips author came up with at the moment, posted between other releases. (Source: MangaDex)

On the full moon of her 21st year, the young witch, Camille Severin, is expected to perform the traditional ritual to summon forth a winged demon for her families success and prosperity. But when the ritual goes wrong, it reveals the terrifying truths about herself and the secrets that threaten to tear her family apart.  


---

If Snow White had lived in feudal Japan, her name probably would’ve been Shirayuki. And she might have escaped an assassination attempt by her jealous stepmother, the Empress. And she likely would have taken a wrong turn during said escape into the Suicide Forest, where she might have stumbled upon the hideout of seven ninjas. And those ninjas probably would have killed her for finding their hideout but then decided against it because they hated the Empress, too. And instead, they could have trained her to be a shinobi as well. And that training might have come in handy for when the Empress found out that Shirayuki was still alive. If that were all to happen, this might be how that story goes down.

(Source: Tapas)

Watanabe is your average outcast. He's a third year in high school, but he looks like a first year. He wants to play soccer, but he sucks at sports. And to top it all off….he's gay. However, when Akihiro, the school giant, comes to his rescue, Jun finds out that looks can be deceiving, first loves are often full of misunderstandings, and what matters most, is not how you look, but what's inside your heart.

display_title: Catch Me! Fight Me! Love Me!
mangabaka_title: Catch Me! Fight Me! Love Me!

titles.title: Catch Me! Fight Me! Love Me!

description: Oriana and Jae-hwa act as a fake married couple for a new online video series.The one rule is that actual "close relationships" aren't allowed to develop and everything is to stay strictly professional.This of course isn't a problem for Oriana because she isn't interested in that and Jae-hwa flat out doesn't care.But maybe their constant interaction with each other might change things around....or make things worse....you never know in the game of love and fakeness~ Follow along if you want to read this ambw inspiring but petty fake married life~

After a heated argument with her family, eighteen-year-old Kokona runs away from home and is magically transported to another world. Dragons, elves, an evil empire, Kokona must defeat the forces of chaos, make new friends, and discover her true destiny as the Summoner.
Source: Tapas

In a rapidly changing world of disappointment, competitive dinosaurs, and a harsh economic climate, can he find hope in the least likely of places or will he burst at the seams?

(Source: Viz Media)

An enemy from afar has threatened to kidnap the king’s daughter. The king springs into action seeking the most elite members of his kingdom to protect her. Sounds like your average everyday fantasy tale. Except that it isn’t… The king is overprotective, the queen can barely tolerate the king, the princess-in-distress is only 7 years old but is strong enough to beat up anyone in the kingdom, and the man or woman who must protect her? He doesn’t have to be the strongest or the smartest…just the LUCKIEST person who ever lived. So yeah, what this tale lacks in tradition, it makes up for in sheer over-the-top lunacy!

(Source: Webtoons)

Ever since her parent's funeral, Florette seems to only find solace in her flower shop and garden. Her love for nature is tested when she meets a tiny plant prince from a miniature plant world. With the “invaders” threatening his plant kingdom, Florette finds her calling to help save the world and its people. Could it be her botanist skills, or is there a bigger connection between Florette and the Kingdom of Soleil?

(Source: Webtoons)

You are safe inside the shining walls of Shiloh, a beautiful utopia in a sea of demons. Unruly vagrants who leave its gates are never seen again, their souls stolen away by monsters and murderers lurking in the wastelands. But not you, valued citizen, for you are smart and know the dangers! Just remember: follow the rules, stay in your caste, and when the time comes... keep your eyes shut.

(Source: Webtoons)

Ever since he was young Mihai had always been intimidating and socially awkward making others avoid him. He grew up to preferring to stay within his social circle that include his grandmother, two friends and his beloved cat Muffins…Well, that how it used to be until he started university and a new neighbour moves in with his friend and she turns out to be almost the exact opposite of him. 

(Source: Webtoons)

Bea is over her ex. Absolutely, completely, over her... except that she's not. When Bea finds out that her ex is also attending her sister's wedding, Bea does what any logical person would do and summons an incredibly hot, sarcastic demon to be her date. But demons are tricky, and now hers won't leave her alone. 

(Source: Webtoon)

In a very special town, there’s a very unusual bakery where the house specialty is a selection of baked treats hand-crafted to help you make your dreams come true – whether you need inspiration, support or confidence, they’ve got a cake or muffin fresh-made with magic to meet your needs. But for Ray, a quiet young woman with special powers of her own, the order is always the same: a hot tea with a delicious side of romance.

(Source: Webtoon)

For work purposes, Noemi's family settled in the estate of one of the wealthiest families in the country. There she meets Blade, the hot-headed prince, and Soren, the illegitimate son. Enjoying simple days of innocence and love, Noemi's happy life quickly shatters into complete darkness. After tragedy, jealousy and betrayal, what will be waiting for Blade, Soren, and Noemi at the end of the road? Will love be able to save them?

(Source: Webtoon)

In a world much like our own, fruit stacking has become the world’s most popular sport…and a young boy named Plum will become that’s sport most beloved underdog. Plum’s journey begins at the gates of Apple Seed City, the living, breathing home of the beloved sport itself. Will he succeed? Can he overcome the odds? The answers can be found up in clouds, as our hero begins his quest to stack higher than anyone before him.

(Source: Line Webtoon)
Special chapters of Age Matters.

After the devastation of WWIV, humans have become virtually extinct and left the rest of the animal kingdom for themselves. Several decades of evolution later, the animals have grown in both population and human-like intelligence. Bucky is the last human on earth, and not everyone is a fan of his human history. He faces constant harassment and discrimination from his animal classmates to which he dreams of eradicating. It's not until he saves an all-powerful killer whale that his simple act of kindness becomes an endless cycle of pandemonium. 

- Webtoons

A series of kidnapping and supernatural occurrences start to happen around Ruby; a timid girl who is accused of being mentally ill even by her closest people. What is the truth behind those tragic events? Hallucination? Or is it the cost she has to pay for her past deed.

- Webtoons

Simon was a shining star in law school, but instead of joining a traditional practice with mortal stakes, he’s about to be thrown into a world of unspeakable courtroom evil. Now, all that stands between peace on Earth and the fall of mankind is Simon’s unique law practice – where demons stand trial and this hungry young attorney sends them back to hell.

(Source: Webtoon)

This is a reboot of the original Tokyopop Series.

Death decides to give his youngest son his first-ever task, but instead of taking a life, he has to protect one instead. The problem is kai has never been to the human world and doesn't know how to act like one either. This means someone's got a Grimreaper as a bodyguard.

(Source: Webtoon)

G-Life follows Arno's life, who has difficulties living as a gay man and hiding his feeling, especially in front of his family. He's still trying to find a way, how to 'come out' and should he do that? Meanwhile, there's a best friend of him, who is really close to him and Arno loves him. But, will his love be accepted by his best friend, who doesn't know that he's gay?

(Source: WebComicsApp)

Jake Baker, the working class warlock, struggles to make ends meet. But with the help of his friends and some down-home DIY magick, he might just keep chaos at bay, and pay his lot fees too...

(Source: Webtoon)
Lenix's Rose is the story of a boy desperate for love(Lenix) and a quiet and cold girl(Rose). A love story that just seems to not progress at all.....

description: A collection of one shots about Team Avatar.

Lily is an adventuresome girl who lives in a boring town where nothing ever happens, but when young girls who stray into the forest near her village begin to go missing, Lily is pulled into a dangerous quest - one that transports her to a strange world that exists right below her feet.(Source: Webtoons)
After seven years of dating, He's changed.. (Source: LINE Webtoon)
~A BL Comic by Eyekno and EAB~ Two imperfect Papa's, with imperfect children, who just might be...perfect for each other. (Source: Webtoon)

Khalid, the Caliph, takes a new bride each night only to have her executed at sunrise. So it is a suspicious surprise when Shahrzad volunteers to marry Khalid. However, Shahrzad has a clever plan - not only to stay alive - but to end the murderous King's reign of terror once and for all. A reimagining of 1001 Nights based on the YA novel by Renee Ahdieh. (Source: Webtoon)

Cat & Cat comics is a cozy, funny, and relatable comic series about more than just cats. Set in a world where pets and humans co-exist in a symbiotic relationship (much like the world we live in today!), Suzy is a human that can understand the mysterious language of cat-speak! Cat & Cat comics dives into the every day interactions between Suzy and her cats, but also the mysterious and magical scenarios that the cats encounter as well. From pancakes growing fluffier upon command to dogs being summoned out of a magical book, these comics are sure to surprise and pull you in for a sweet treat!

Being reunited with a childhood friend after many years apart? Sounds like a heart-warming story. Finding out that said friend, (not only changed so much that was impossible to recognize her), is now a complete grown-up woman who's determined to make me hers? Not so much.. Plus her timing couldn't be any worse.

Every day is a romantic comedy. A silly love story between a spoiled succubus and a young maiden.

(Source: Line WebToon)

What do you value most? And if it was taken from you, what would you do to get it back? Join four strangers as they are transported to the mythical land of Luggage – and set out on a quest to locate lost items of great personal value. Along the way, they must make hard decisions about what’s important to them, and what must be left behind in order to retrieve what has been lost.

(Source: Webtoon)

"Just let me be your pet"
Ken will do anything to catch Yuuzuki attention.

(source: Webcomicsapp.com)

Plenty of teenagers would kill for a chance to leave Earth behind and journey to Mars. But for Cal, that situation is pretty much reversed. One of only seven people ever born on the Red Planet, Cal dreams of returning to the homeland of his parents where, despite its many flaws, he can be free to live life his way. But Cal’s plan of getting back to Earth may have to be put on hold, as an unknown presence threatens the very existence of the boy, his family and everyone who now calls Mars their home.

(Source: Webtoon)

Marius Bellemore, lord and protector of the vampire race, chooses to ally himself with the last surviving witch of the Redwood circle. That, in itself, is a strange fact for vampires and witches have been enemies for centuries.

(Source: Webtoon)
Just a boy and a rat out here collecting powers

Just 2 guys bein' dudes.

(Source: LINE Webtoon)

Vasilyi is a student of architectural college. He is shy, modest but very kind person. Thanks to Alexander, his school life is very adventurous and cheerful. Alexander is the center of every company and everybody loves him. What could connect such different people? And why friends are always teasing them about their another kind of relations? Maybe they should really think about situation and why they feel so good near each other? Or they should continue kicking around this topic? The thing is that its always much easier to talk about serious stuff in not serious manner.
Short comic strips of a mermaid in the modern days. (Source: Webtoon)

With his rainbow-colored hair and love of all things fashion, Arcus is anything BUT your average teenager. He’s an upbeat independent thinker, proud fashionista, and like the rest of us, is just looking for a few friends to call his own. Acception may be Arcus’ story – but it’s all OUR stories too - and it is for anyone who’s ever struggled to fit in, find love, or thought that High School was pretty much the worst thing ever invented.

(Source: Line Webtoon)
How two best friends became a couple.

description: After his battle with Frieza, Son Goku lands on a strange planet: Planet Yardrat. There, our Saiyan will discover a people and a surprising technique.

Everything happens for a reason, even the guy with the weird hair at the train station that apparently ruined your life.

(Source: LINE Webtoon)

It’s senior year and Sara Lin just turned 18. She’s got great friends, a cool Dad (or so he thinks) and a whole lot ahead of her. The last thing she needs is to worry about having her first kiss. But that’s all about to change because her good pal Patrick just challenged her to a bet that will either lead to love, heartbreak or embarrassment…or maybe all three.

(Source: Webtoon)

"An otome-obsessed girl is given the chance of a lifetime when she receives an invitation from her favorite dating sim company, opiichii, to beta test real life AIs from her first ever otome, 会いたい (aitai). What happens when fiction becomes reality?"

(Source: WebComicApp)

Coming from a family unable to make ends meet, Hazel works hard and toils away day after day, focused only on getting one step closer to her dream. One day, she unexpectedly meets someone who teaches her to live and cherish life instead of letting it revolve on ambition. Is this a work of fate? Where would this encounter take them? Would they sacrifice love to follow their dreams?

Wetzel, Shelby, and Ebus may be brothers, but that doesn't mean they understand each other -- or women. Follow their wacky shenanigans as these three eccentric wizards try to run a struggling tavern on Hero's Road, file their taxes, and refill the pickle jar. Laugh so hard your lungs punch your eyeballs! Learn more about cooking than you ever wanted to know! Realize you're probably going to hell for laughing at this!

- Webtoons

In a universe where animal-human hybrids exist, follow the short stories of seven hybrids who find compassion and love in a world that views them as lesser beings. These hybrids' lives, though unaware of one another's existences, are intertwined through events that are much larger than themselves.

He's a very serious genetically enhanced super-soldier. She's a less serious sugar-addicted mercenary. Together they're the best work-for-hire duo in the galaxy.

(Source: Webtoon)

Having enough of her life as a slave to the princes of Dakae, the former aristocrat Cerys decides to escape. Literally stumbling over a powerful vampire was NOT part of her plan though...

(Source: Webtoons)
Ian didn't pass the test. To make matters worse, his boyfriend Sam didn't show up in class to comfort him. He's the only one who could cheer Ian up right now.

Since a traumatic event in his childhood, Haruki Watanabe is afraid of water. Haruki tries to repress his past as much as possible. But everything changes when he meets the attractive sailing teacher Kaito Asahi... 

(Source: Webtoons)
Comic Book tie-in with the Detective Pikachu movie.

Edith is not your typical heroine. She struggles with her confidence, her morals, and life in general by not only holding herself to high standards, but her men as well. Enter two less-than-perfect men: one who may be the Prince Charming she’s been waiting for to deliver a fairy tale ending, the other a brash reality check who does NOT believe in happily-ever-after. What will Edith do? Will she sacrifice her standards? Or keep searching for that mythical white knight who may or may not exist in the first place? Funny, messy and sexy, Edith’s journey is relatable to anyone who’s ever left their heart on the battlefield of the dating world.

(Source: Webtoon)

Apathetic is the word. But when there's someone who hates him to the point of abuse there is no way he is going to take that in and do nothing about it. BL webcomic. Be advised of verbal language, abuse, and mature content. Updates twice a month. 

(Source: Webtoon)

Layla just wants a new, quiet start in Yomanville. However, along with the relocation, comes new faces... and new feelings for her. Good thing she's confident and great under pressure--oh wait, that's not right. - Who wrote this synopsis?! - Anyway, join Layla, Dylan, Sally, Marv and Joe, as well as some rather unsavoury characters, in Da Yomanville Gang!

(Source: Webtoon)

In this world, magic is normal. The world is divided into four countries with a different element and each country has three clans. Together they are fighting demon forces invading this world every day. The story is placed after The Great War defeating demon army. Reo, the main protagonist, is born into a royal family after his mother was chosen by the Gods to lead a Blue Water Clan.

(Source: Webtoons)

It’s hard to believe, but high school is ending. This is a tragedy for some and a huge relief for others— namely Tulip and Sydney, who can’t wait to pass their final exams and graduate. However, their best friend Camila is determined to make the most of their last months together. This story follows a group of teens navigating the emotional whirlwind that is the end of what's supposed to be the 'best years of their lives'. ..."SUPPOSED.

Witches are evil beings that exists to bring despair to all. In fairy tales, they are the villains fated to never meet a happy end. Legends has it that there is a witch who roams the land in search of dreams that manifest in the hearts of humans in an attempt to maintain her eternal youth. Nightmares follow in her wake and her presence brings fear to those who hear her name. This is the story of the witch Lucid.

Getting crushed by your crush. Coming out to your parents. Learning that your sister is your biggest dating rival. High school sure does have its share of twists, turns and moments of high drama. To get through it all with your smile and sanity intact, you’re going to need some friends. Really good friends. Friends like Johnny, Mariel, Gaby and Martina who, one way or another, will find a way to get through their teenage years together.

(Source: Webtoon)

Ayden seems to live a pretty normal life…normal that is except for the voice in his head haunting him 24/7. It takes meeting Maggie, the cute barista, to uncover the horrifying truth behind the madness. Together with Maggie, Ayden discovers that the voice in his head is actually a servant of a demonic force who collects souls once they've matured on their 30th year. With Ayden's birthday just around the corner, he and Maggie join forces to find an alternative to their fated demise.

(Source: Webtoon)
